a16a.title: A Rumour in Liangzhou
steps: In the first village, the word goes round: Wang Yun means to wipe out every man of Liangzhou.
遂流言于西凉州曰：“王允将欲洗荡此方之人矣。”

a16b.title: Fear
steps: By the second village it has run ahead of them. The people are terrified.

a16c.title: Will You Follow Me?
steps: In the third, they put the question plainly: Why die for nothing? Will you rise with us? And every man will.
乃复扬言曰：“徒死无益，能从我反乎？”众皆愿从。

a16m.title: The March on Chang'an
steps: They gather more than a hundred thousand men, split them into four columns, and march on Chang'an. On the road they meet Dong Zhuo's son-in-law, Niu Fu, coming with five thousand men to avenge him. Li Jue joins forces with him, and sends him on ahead.
于是聚众十余万，分作四路，杀奔长安来。路逢董卓女婿中郎将牛辅，引军五千人，欲去与丈人报仇，李傕便与合兵，使为前驱。

a16m_wait.title: Not Enough Men
steps: Not yet. There are villages still that haven't heard.
还不可。尚有乡里未闻此言。

a17.title: Gong to Advance, Drum to Withdraw
steps: Lü Bu sends Li Su out against them. Li Su beats Niu Fu in the first fight, but that night, the second watch, Niu Fu raids his camp. Li Su loses half his army and flees thirty li. Lü Bu is furious, has him beheaded, and hangs his head at the camp gate.
布遂引李肃将兵出敌。肃当先迎战，正与牛辅相遇，大杀一阵。不想是夜二更，牛辅乘肃不备，竟来劫寨。肃军乱窜，败走三十余里，折军大半。布大怒，遂斩李肃，悬头军门。

The next day Lü Bu beats Niu Fu himself. That night Niu Fu slips away with his gold and a few men. At a river crossing his own man, Hu Chi'er, kills him for the gold and takes the head to Lü Bu. Niu Fu's men tell the truth, and Lü Bu has Hu Chi'er killed too.
次日，吕布进兵与牛辅对敌，牛辅大败而走。是夜牛辅暗藏金珠，弃营而走。将渡一河，胡赤儿欲谋取金珠，竟杀死牛辅，将头来献吕布。从人出首，布怒，即将赤儿诛杀。

Lü Bu is brave but has no strategy. Nothing to fear. I'll hold the mouth of Ren Valley and draw him out to fight every day. General Guo, you hit him from behind. We'll do what Peng Yue did to wear down Chu: sound the gong to advance, beat the drum to withdraw. Zhang and Fan split their forces and go straight for Chang'an. He can't save his head and his tail at once. He's sure to be beaten.
吕布虽勇，然而无谋，不足为虑。我引军守任谷口，每日诱他厮杀。郭将军可领军抄击其后，效彭越挠楚之法，鸣金进兵，擂鼓收兵。张、樊二公，却分兵两路，径取长安。彼首尾不能救应，必然大败。

Lü Bu charges up the hill, and stones and arrows rain down on him. Guo Si's men strike from behind. He turns, and the drums roll, and they are gone. He means to withdraw, and the gongs ring, and Li Jue is on him again. Day after day it goes on. He can neither fight nor stop.
布忿怒冲杀过去，傕退走上山。山上矢石如雨，布军不能进。郭汜在阵后杀来，布急回战。只闻鼓声大震，汜军已退。布方欲收军，锣声响处，傕军又来。一连如此几日，欲战不得，欲止不得。
Then a rider brings word: Zhang Ji and Fan Chou are at Chang'an. Lü Bu hurries back, and loses many men on the way.
忽然飞马报来，说张济、樊稠两路军马，竟犯长安，京城危急。布急领军回，折了好些人马。

a18p.title: To Save Myself by Running
steps: A few days later, Li Meng and Wang Fang, Dong Zhuo's men still inside the city, secretly open the gates, and the rebel armies pour in from all four sides.
数日之后，董卓余党李蒙、王方在城中为贼内应，偷开城门，四路贼军一齐拥入。
It's hopeless! Mount up, Minister, and come out through the pass with me. We'll find another way.
势急矣！请司徒上马，同出关去，别图良策。

If the spirits of the dynasty help me bring the realm to peace, that is all I wish. If not, I give my life. To save myself by running in a crisis: that I will not do. Thank the lords east of the pass for me, and tell them to keep the realm in their hearts!
若蒙社稷之灵，得安国家，吾之愿也；若不获已，则允奉身以死。临难苟免，吾不为也。为吾谢关东诸公，努力以国家为念！

Lü Bu begs him again and again, but Wang Yun will not go. Soon flames rise from every gate to the sky. Lü Bu has to leave his own family behind, and flees through the pass with a hundred riders, to join Yuan Shu.
吕布再三相劝，王允只是不肯去。不一时，各门火焰竟天，吕布只得弃却家小，引百余骑飞奔出关，投袁术去了。

a18.title: Wang Yun Is Here
steps: Li Jue and Guo Si let their men loot the city. Minister after minister dies for the dynasty. The rebels close round the inner palace, and the Emperor's attendants beg him to go up on the Xuanping Gate tower to stop the slaughter.
李傕、郭汜纵兵大掠，众臣多死于国难。贼兵围绕内庭至急，侍臣请天子上宣平门止乱。
Seeing the yellow canopy, Li Jue and Guo Si hold back their men, and cry: Long live the Emperor!
李傕等望见黄盖，约住军士，口呼万岁。
You came into Chang'an without waiting for my summons. What do you mean by it?
卿不候奏请，辄入长安，意欲何为？
Grand Preceptor Dong was the pillar of Your Majesty's throne, and Wang Yun murdered him for nothing. We've come only to avenge him, not to rebel. Give us Wang Yun, and we'll withdraw.
董太师乃陛下社稷之臣，无端被王允谋杀，臣等特来报仇，非敢造反。但见王允，臣便退兵。
Everything I did was for the realm. Now it has come to this, Your Majesty must not spare me and ruin the nation. Let me go down to these two rebels.
臣本为社稷计。事已至此，陛下不可惜臣，以误国家。臣请下见二贼。
The Emperor hesitates, and cannot bear it. Wang Yun leaps down from the Xuanping Gate tower, crying out:
帝徘徊不忍。允自宣平门楼上跳下楼去，大呼曰：
What crime had the Grand Preceptor committed, that you killed him?
Dong Zhuo's crimes filled heaven and earth, more than words can tell. The day he died, everyone in Chang'an rejoiced. Have you alone not heard?
董贼之罪，弥天亘地，不可胜言。受诛之日，长安士民，皆相庆贺，汝独不闻乎？
So the Grand Preceptor was guilty. What were we guilty of, that you wouldn't pardon us?
太师有罪；我等何罪，不肯相赦？
Traitors, why waste words? I, Wang Yun, have only death today!
逆贼何必多言！我王允今日有死而已！
The two rebels raise their swords, and Wang Yun is cut down below the tower.
二贼手起，把王允杀于楼下。
They send men to kill his whole clan, old and young. Scholars and common people alike weep for him.
众贼杀了王允，一面又差人将王允宗族老幼，尽行杀害。士民无不下泪。
Then Li Jue and Guo Si think: having come this far, why not kill the Son of Heaven and take the great prize? They draw their swords and storm into the palace, shouting.
当下李傕、郭汜寻思曰：“既到这里，不杀天子谋大事，更待何时？”便持剑大呼，杀入内来。
What became of Emperor Xian? Hear the next chapter.
未知献帝性命如何，且听下文分解。

opening: Minister Wang cleverly sets the chain of schemes; Grand Preceptor Dong storms the Phoenix Pavilion.
Dong Zhuo has burned Luoyang and moved the court west to Chang'an. The lords who rose against him have fallen to fighting one another.
In Chang'an he does as he pleases, with Lü Bu, the strongest warrior alive, at his side as his adopted son. No minister dares to speak.
王司徒巧使连环计，董太师大闹凤仪亭。
董卓火烧洛阳，迁都长安。起兵讨董的诸侯，已自相攻伐。
长安城中，董卓为所欲为。天下第一猛将吕布，是他的义子，随侍左右。满朝公卿，无人敢言。

dilemma.q: Stake the whole house on a sixteen-year-old girl?
dilemma.open: If it leaks, every one of us dies. But no one else can do it.
dilemma.slip: Not yet. Let me think it through.
dilemma.q_zh: 以一门性命，托付二八少女？
dilemma.open_zh: 事若泄漏，我灭门矣。可满朝文武，无计可施。

gate.objective: Fetch the family pearls from the old steward, in your rear hall.
Take the pearls to the jeweller's, at the west end of the market street, to be set into a gold crown.

dilemma.q: Get the crown to Lü Bu unseen.
dilemma.open: The Chancellor's men are everywhere. After Zhang Wen, one wrong step is the end.
dilemma.win: It is done, and no one saw.
dilemma.q_zh: 将金冠密送吕布，勿令人知。
dilemma.open_zh: 相府耳目遍布。张温之事在前，一步差错，万事皆休。

dilemma.open: Pour the wine, and let him look.
dilemma.win: He cannot take his eyes off me.
dilemma.open_zh: 且斟酒，任他看。

dilemma.q: Make the Grand Preceptor take me.
dilemma.open: Behind the curtain, he can only half see. Let that be enough.
dilemma.win: Truly one of the immortals, he says.
dilemma.open_zh: 隔着帘栊，他只看得半分。半分足矣。

dilemma.open: His hand is on my collar. One wrong word and the plan dies, and I with it.
dilemma.slip: He'll see through that. Think again.
dilemma.open_zh: 他手揪我衣襟。一言有失，大计皆休，老夫亦死。

dilemma.open: He is watching from the pond. Let him see a woman in pain.
dilemma.slip: Too much. He'll see it's an act.
dilemma.open_zh: 他在池边窥看。便让他看一个受苦的女子。

dilemma.q: Tell him, without waking the man between us.
dilemma.open: One sign, and not a sound.
dilemma.open_zh: 只一个手势，不出一声。

dilemma.open: He came. Now every word has to ring true.
dilemma.open_zh: 他来了。如今句句都要像真的。

dilemma.open: He fears the old man. Make him fear losing me more.
dilemma.open_zh: 他怕那老贼。要教他更怕失去我。

dilemma.open: The greatest hero alive, taking orders. Let him hear how that sounds.
dilemma.win: He will not let me go.
dilemma.slip: Too sharp. He'll turn on me.
dilemma.open_zh: 当世英雄，竟受人制。让他听听这话。

dilemma.open: Lü Bu chased me, and I nearly drowned. Make him see it.
dilemma.open_zh: 是吕布追我，我险些投池。要他看得真切。

dilemma.q: Put the sword to my throat.
dilemma.open: A real blade. He has to believe I'd rather die.
dilemma.open_zh: 真刀真剑。要他信我宁死不从。

dilemma.open: Give him someone to blame who isn't me.
dilemma.win: He will never give me up.
dilemma.open_zh: 给他一个可怪的人，不是我。

dilemma.open: He is angry. Make the shame his own.
dilemma.open_zh: 他已动怒。要让这耻辱成了他自己的。

dilemma.open: One sentence has to cut the tie.
dilemma.open_zh: 一句话，便要斩断这父子之情。

dilemma.open: Give him a name in the histories to choose.
dilemma.open_zh: 让他自己选，青史留下什么名字。

dilemma.open: After Zhang Wen, every friend may be an informer.
dilemma.open_zh: 张温之后，故人亦未可信。

dilemma.open: One more, and no more.
dilemma.open_zh: 再一人，便够了。

dilemma.open: He is the one man Dong Zhuo listens to. Is he Dong Zhuo's, or the Han's?
dilemma.slip: He's guarded. Watch him more closely.
dilemma.open_zh: 太师唯听此人之言。他是董卓的人，还是汉家的人？

dilemma.open: The Chancellor's men watch every door of the palace.
dilemma.win: The edict is in my sleeve.
dilemma.open_zh: 宫中门门皆有相府耳目。

dilemma.open: He never promoted me. And Lü Bu will kill me if I say no.
dilemma.open_zh: 他从不迁我官。况我若不从，吕布先斩我。

dilemma.open: He reads men for a living. One flicker and I'm dead.
dilemma.win: He dreamed of a dragon, he says.
dilemma.open_zh: 此人阅人无数。一丝破绽，我便死了。

dilemma.open: Heaven itself is warning him. Make it sound like good news.
dilemma.open_zh: 天在警他。要说成吉兆。

dilemma.q: Explain away the wind and the fog.
dilemma.open: Darkness at noon. Make it majesty.
dilemma.win: He has no doubt at all.
dilemma.open_zh: 白日昏暗。要说成天威。

dilemma.open: The song says his name, and says he dies. Turn it round.
dilemma.win: The house of Dong will rise.
dilemma.open_zh: 童谣暗藏其名，又说他死。要反过来说。

dilemma.q: Get the carriage through the gate.
dilemma.open: His guards are shut outside. Only the carriage men come in.
dilemma.open_zh: 卫兵都挡在门外，只有车驾进来。

dilemma.open: He has seen the swords. Don't answer him, and don't stop.
dilemma.win: He is inside. The soldiers are coming.
dilemma.open_zh: 他已看见了剑。不要答话，不要停。

dilemma.open: The blades won't go in. Only one man can do this.
dilemma.win: There is an edict to kill a traitor!
dilemma.slip: He's calling for his son. Hold.
dilemma.open_zh: 刀枪不入。只有一人能了结他。

dilemma.open: If they run alone, a village constable will take them. Together, they can take Chang'an.
dilemma.open_zh: 若各自逃生，一亭长能缚之。合兵，则长安可取。

dilemma.open: Fear will raise an army faster than gold.
dilemma.open_zh: 恐惧聚兵，快过金银。

dilemma.open: It has run ahead of us. Keep it running.
dilemma.open_zh: 流言已先我而至。让它再传。

dilemma.open: Why die for nothing?
dilemma.open_zh: 徒死无益。

gate.objective: Spread the rumour through the villages of Liangzhou.

dilemma.q: Hold Lü Bu at the mouth of Ren Valley.
dilemma.open: He is brave, and nothing else. Never let him fight the battle he wants.
dilemma.win: He can neither fight nor stop.
dilemma.open_zh: 他只有勇而已。决不教他打想打的仗。

worlds.name: White Gate Tower
couplets: 呂奉先射戟轅門　曹孟德敗師淯水
Lü Fengxian shoots the halberd at the camp gate; Cao Mengde is routed on the Yu river
下邳城曹操鏖兵　白門樓呂布殞命
Cao Cao battles at Xiapi; Lü Bu dies at White Gate Tower

x0a.title: Left Behind
steps: Chang'an, the night it falls. Dong Zhuo's old generals Li Jue and Guo Si are inside the walls, and flames rise from every gate.
李傕、郭汜兵入長安，各門火燄竟天。
Lü Bu cannot hold the city. He has to leave his family behind, and rides out through the pass with a hundred horsemen.
呂布只得棄卻家小，引百餘騎飛奔出關。
Li Jue and Guo Si turn their soldiers loose to plunder the city.
Pang Shu, an officer in Chang'an, takes Lü Bu's wife and child in, in secret.
時龐舒在長安城中，私藏呂布妻小。

x0b.title: Hidden
steps: In Pang Shu's house they stay hidden, while the city outside is plundered.
Far away, Lü Bu wanders. Yuan Shu will not take him in. Yuan Shao takes him in, then wants him dead. At last Zhang Yang takes him in.
呂布逃出武關，去投袁術；術拒而不納。投袁紹，紹納之；紹欲殺之，布乃去投張揚，揚納之。
Then Pang Shu sends Lü Bu's wife and child back to him.
Li Jue and Guo Si find out. They behead Pang Shu, and write to Zhang Yang telling him to kill Lü Bu. So Lü Bu leaves Zhang Yang and moves on.
李傕、郭汜知之，遂斬龐舒，寫書與張揚，教殺呂布；布因棄張揚去投張邈。
With Chen Gong, Lü Bu seized Yanzhou while Cao Cao was away, and at Puyang Chen Gong's fire trap nearly killed Cao Cao. But Cao Cao drove them out.
With nowhere left to go, Lü Bu turned to Liu Bei, who had just taken charge of Xuzhou.
呂布與陳宮乘曹操東征，襲取兗州。陳宮設計火燒濮陽，曹操幾死；終被曹操所破。
無處安身，呂布乃投新領徐州的劉玄德。

x1.title: A Guest at Xuzhou
steps: Beaten by Cao Cao and turned away by Yuan Shao, Lü Bu comes with Chen Gong to Xuzhou, where Liu Bei has just taken charge. Liu Bei rides out thirty li to meet him, and they enter the city side by side.
呂布為曹操所破，袁紹又不相容，乃與陳宮投徐州來。玄德新領徐州，出城三十里接著呂布，並馬入城。
Since Minister Wang and I killed Dong Zhuo, I have wandered east of the passes, and the lords will not have me. I come to you, to plan great things together. What do you say?
某自與王司徒計殺董卓之後，又遭傕、汜之變，飄零關東，諸侯多不能相容。今投使君，共圖大事，未審尊意如何？
Governor Tao has just died, and no one governs Xuzhou, so I hold it for now. Now that you are here, General, it should be yours.
陶使君新逝，無人管領徐州，因令備權攝州事。今幸將軍至此，合當相讓。
Liu Bei holds out the seal of office. Lü Bu reaches for it, and sees Guan Yu and Zhang Fei behind Liu Bei, glaring.
遂將牌印與呂布。呂布卻待要接，只見玄德背後關、張二公各有怒色。
Ha! What would a fighting man like me do with a province?
量呂布一勇夫，何能作州牧乎？
A strong guest does not push out his host. Please, my lord, have no doubts.
強賓不壓主，請使君勿疑。
Liu Bei gives way. A banquet is set out, and quarters are found for Lü Bu's household.
玄德方止。遂設宴相待，收拾宅院安下。

x2.title: Wife and Daughter
steps: The next day Lü Bu returns the banquet. Liu Bei comes with Guan Yu and Zhang Fei. When the wine is half drunk, Lü Bu invites Liu Bei into his rear hall.
次日，呂布回席請玄德，玄德乃與關、張同往。飲酒至半酣，布請玄德入後堂。關、張隨入。
Lü Bu has his wife and daughter come out and bow to Liu Bei. Liu Bei declines again and again.
布令妻女出拜玄德。玄德再三謙讓。
No need for ceremony, little brother.
My brother is of the imperial blood! What are you, to call him little brother? Come on! Three hundred bouts, you and me!
我哥哥是金枝玉葉，你是何等人，敢稱我哥哥為賢弟！你來！我和你鬥三百合！
My brother talks wildly in his cups. Don't hold it against him.
劣弟酒後狂言，兄勿見責。

Lü Bu says nothing. The next day he comes to take his leave: your brothers will never accept me. Liu Bei offers him Xiaopei, a small town nearby, where he once kept his own troops. Lü Bu thanks him and moves there.
布默默無語。次日呂布來辭玄德，恐令弟輩不能相容。玄德曰：「近邑小沛，乃備昔日屯兵之處。將軍不嫌淺狹，權且歇馬。」呂布謝了玄德，自引軍投小沛安身去了。

x3.title: Two Tigers
steps: From the capital comes an edict naming Liu Bei governor of Xuzhou, and with it a secret letter from Cao Cao: kill Lü Bu. Cao Cao's advisers call it the scheme of two tigers fighting over the same meat.
曹操奏請詔命，封劉備為徐州牧，並附密書一封，教殺呂布。此乃荀彧『二虎競食之計』也。
Yide, why do you want to kill me?
Cao Cao says you're a man without honour, and tells my brother to kill you!
曹操道你是無義之人，教我哥哥殺你！
Liu Bei sends Zhang Fei out, takes Lü Bu into the rear hall, and shows him the letter.
玄德連聲喝退。乃引呂布同入後堂，就將曹操所送密書與呂布看。
Cao the traitor wants to set the two of us against each other!
此乃曹賊欲令二人不和耳！
Don't worry, brother. I swear I will do no such dishonourable thing.
兄勿憂：劉備誓不為此不義之事。

Soon after, Liu Bei marches south against Yuan Shu and leaves Zhang Fei to hold Xuzhou. Zhang Fei drinks, and has Cao Bao flogged for refusing a cup. Cao Bao is Lü Bu's father-in-law. That night his letter reaches Xiaopei: Zhang Fei is drunk. Come tonight, and Xuzhou is yours.
後玄德往淮南拒袁術，留張飛守徐州。張飛大醉，鞭打曹豹。豹乃呂布之岳父，深恨張飛，連夜差人齎書投小沛：「今夜可乘飛醉，引兵來襲徐州。」
Xiaopei was never a place to stay long. If you miss this chance at Xuzhou, you'll regret it.
小沛原非久居之地。今徐州既有可乘之隙，失此不取，悔之晚矣。

x4.title: The Night Gate
steps: The fourth watch, and a clear moon. On the wall nobody has noticed them.
恰纔四更，月色澄清，城上更不知覺。
A secret messenger from Lord Liu!
Cao Bao's men report it, and Cao Bao has the gate opened. At Lü Bu's signal his men pour in.
城上有曹豹軍報知曹豹，豹上城看之，便令軍士開門。呂布一聲暗號，眾軍齊入，喊聲大舉。
Zhang Fei, still drunk, cannot fight. Eighteen horsemen get him out through the east gate, and Cao Bao, chasing him, dies in the river.
張飛酒猶未醒，不能力戰，十八騎燕將保著張飛，殺出東門。曹豹趕來，被張飛一槍刺死於河中。
Lü Bu takes the city. He sets a hundred men to guard the gate of Liu Bei's house, and lets no one in.
呂布入城安撫居民，令軍士一百人守把玄德宅門，諸人不許擅入。

x5.title: The Halberd at the Camp Gate
steps: Lü Bu holds Xuzhou now, and Liu Bei holds Xiaopei. Yuan Shu sends his general Ji Ling with a hundred thousand men against Liu Bei, and Liu Bei begs Lü Bu for help. If Yuan Shu swallows Liu Bei, Lü Bu reasons, he will be next.
呂布居徐州，玄德屯小沛。袁術遣紀靈統兵十萬攻小沛，玄德求救於布。布曰：「若袁術併了玄德，則北連泰山諸將以圖我，不若救玄德。」
He invites both Liu Bei and Ji Ling to a banquet in his camp. Ji Ling sees Liu Bei at the table and turns to go. Lü Bu hauls him back like a child.
乃請紀靈、劉備飲宴。紀靈入寨，卻見玄德在帳上坐，大驚，抽身便回。呂布向前一把扯回，如提童稚。
Do you mean to kill me, General?
I've never liked a fight. I like ending them. Today I'll settle it between you, and Heaven will decide how.
布平生不好鬥，惟好解鬥。吾今為兩家解之。吾有一法，從天所決。
My lord sent me with a hundred thousand men to take Liu Bei. How can I stop now?
吾奉主公之命，提十萬之兵，專捉劉備，如何罷得？
We're few, but you lot are children to me! Were you worth a million Yellow Turbans?
吾雖兵少，覷汝輩如兒戲耳！你比百萬黃巾何如？
The camp gate is a hundred and fifty paces off. If my arrow hits the small blade of that halberd, you both stand down. If I miss, go back to your camps and fight. Whoever refuses, I'll fight myself.
轅門離中軍一百五十步，吾若一箭射中戟上小枝，你兩家罷兵；如射不中時，各自回營，安排廝殺。有不從吾言者，併力拒之。
Ji Ling thinks: at a hundred and fifty paces, how can he hit it? He agrees at once. Liu Bei prays under his breath that he will.
紀靈私忖：「戟在一百五十步之外，安能便中？」便一口許諾。玄德暗祝曰：「只願他射得中便好！」
The bow opens like the autumn moon crossing the sky; the arrow falls like a shooting star. It strikes the small blade of the halberd square. The whole camp roars.
弓開如秋月行天，箭去似流星落地。一箭正中畫戟小枝。帳上帳下將校，齊聲喝采。
Heaven itself bids you both stand down!
The next day all three armies march away.

x6.title: A Match for a Princess
steps: Yuan Shu changes his plan. His envoy Han Yin comes asking for Lü Bu's daughter as a wife for Yuan Shu's son. Lü Bu has two wives and a concubine: Lady Yan, his first wife; Diaochan, his concubine; and his second wife, Cao Bao's daughter, who has died childless. Diaochan has no child either. Only Lady Yan has given him one: a daughter, the one he loves most.
袁術遣韓胤為媒，往徐州求親。原來呂布有二妻一妾：先娶嚴氏為正妻，後娶貂蟬為妾；又娶曹豹之女為次妻。曹氏先亡無出，貂蟬亦無所出，惟嚴氏生一女，布最鍾愛。
Lü Bu goes in to consult his wife.
I hear Yuan Gonglu has held the Huainan for years, with troops and grain in plenty. Any day now he'll be emperor. If he succeeds, our daughter could be an empress. How many sons does he have?
吾聞袁公路久鎮淮南，兵多糧廣，早晚將為天子。若成大事，則吾女有后妃之望；只不知他有幾子？
Then we accept. Even if she's never empress, Xuzhou will have nothing to fear.
既如此，即當許之。縱不為皇后，吾徐州亦無憂矣。
Lü Bu's mind is made up.
The lords are all at each other's throats. If you choose a distant wedding day, someone may waylay the bride on the road. Send her to Shouchun now, before anyone knows, and fix the day there.
方今天下諸侯，互相爭雄；若復遠擇吉期，或竟乘我良辰，伏兵半路以奪之，如之奈何？當趁諸侯未知之時，即便送女到壽春，另居別館，然後擇吉成親。
That night the dowry is made ready, and the bride is sent out of the city with Han Yin, to drums and music.
連夜具辦妝奩，令宋憲、魏續一同韓胤送女前去。鼓樂喧天，送出城外。

x7.title: The Condolence Call
steps: The old minister Chen Gui hears the drums from his sickbed, and has himself carried to Lü Bu.
陳珪養老在家，聞鼓樂之聲，遂扶病來見呂布。
I heard you were dead, General, so I came to mourn.
What do you mean by that?

Yuan Shu wants your daughter as a hostage. Then he'll take Xiaopei, and Xuzhou is next. He'll come asking for grain and troops; give them and you wear yourself out, refuse and you break with your own kin. And he means to call himself emperor. Then you're a rebel's father-in-law, and the whole realm will turn on you.
其意蓋欲以公女為質，隨後就來攻玄德而取小沛。小沛亡，徐州危矣。且彼或來借糧，或來借兵；公若應之，是疲於奔命；若其不允，是棄親而啟兵端也。況聞袁術已有稱帝之意，是造反也。彼若造反，則公乃反賊親屬矣，得無為天下所不容乎？
Chen Gong has misled me! Zhang Liao, after them!
陳宮誤我！張遼，急引兵追趕之！

x8.title: Thirty Li
steps: Thirty li out, Zhang Liao catches the bridal party, and brings the girl home. Han Yin is taken back too, and held.
三十里之外將女搶歸；連韓胤都拏回監禁。
A message goes to Yuan Shu: the dowry wasn't ready. She'll be sent when it is.
卻令人回復袁術，只說女兒妝奩未備，俟備畢便自送來。

x9.title: The Hawk
steps: Cao Cao sends an edict making Lü Bu a general. Then Yuan Shu's envoy arrives: Yuan Shu will soon be emperor, and the princess must come at once. Lü Bu kills the envoy, and sends Han Yin in a cangue to Cao Cao with Chen Gui's son, Chen Deng, to ask to be made governor of Xuzhou.
曹操遣使封布為平東將軍。袁術使者來曰：「袁公早晚即皇帝位，催取皇妃早到淮南。」布大怒，遂殺來使，遣陳登解韓胤上許都，欲求實授徐州牧。
Chen Deng comes back with rank and pay for his father and a governorship for himself, and nothing for Lü Bu.
登回徐州，言父贈祿，某為太守。
You didn't ask for Xuzhou for me, you asked for rank for yourselves! You and your father have sold me!
汝不為吾求徐州牧，而乃自求爵祿！吾為汝父子所賣耳！

General, how can you be so blind? I told Lord Cao: keep the General like a tiger. Feed him full, or he'll eat men. Lord Cao laughed: no. I keep him like a hawk. While the foxes and hares still run, I don't feed him full. Hungry, he hunts. Full, he flies away.
將軍何其不明之甚也！吾見曹公，言養將軍譬如養虎，當飽其肉；不飽則將噬人。曹公笑曰：『不如卿言。吾待溫侯，如養鷹耳，狐兔未息，不敢先飽。饑則為用，飽則颺去。』
And who are the foxes and hares?
Yuan Shu, Sun Ce, Yuan Shao, Liu Biao, Liu Zhang, Zhang Lu. All of them.
淮南袁術、江東孫策、冀州袁紹、荊州劉表、益州劉璋、漢中張魯，皆狐兔也。
Chen Gong watches the Chens with growing unease.
陳宮見陳珪父子日親，心中不安。

x10.title: The Hunt
steps: Chen Gong had warned Lü Bu: the Chen father and son flatter you to your face, and no one knows their hearts. Lü Bu called it slander. Chen Gong went out sighing: honest words go unheard, and we will all pay for it. Now, out hunting near Xiaopei to ease his mind, he sees a courier galloping along the post road, and rides him down by a side path.
陳宮告布曰：「陳珪父子面諛將軍，其心不可測。」布怒叱之。宮出歎曰：「忠言不入，吾輩必受殃矣。」一日，去小沛地面圍獵解悶，忽見官道上一騎驛馬飛奔前去。宮疑之，引從騎從小路趕上。
The man can't answer. Chen Gong has him searched, and finds Liu Bei's secret reply to Cao Cao.
那使者慌不能答。陳宮令搜其身，得玄德回答曹操密書一封。
Your command is to destroy Lü Bu. I am at your service day and night. If you march, I will lead the way.
奉明命欲圖呂布，敢不夙夜用心？丞相若興大師，備當為前驅。
Chen Gong takes the man and the letter to Lü Bu. Lü Bu beheads the messenger and goes to war on Liu Bei.
宮即連人與書，拿見呂布。布遂將使者斬首，令高順、張遼取沛城，攻玄德。

x11.title: The Family Moves
steps: Liu Bei flees to Cao Cao, and Cao Cao marches east with him. Lü Bu means to go to Xiao Pass, where Chen Gong is holding the road.
玄德投曹操。操親提大軍，與玄德來戰呂布。布欲往救蕭關。
Xuzhou has enemies on four sides. Move your money and grain to Xiapi first. If Xuzhou is besieged, Xiapi will have grain to save it.
徐州四面受敵，操必力攻，我當先思退步。可將錢糧移於下邳，倘徐州被圍，下邳有糧可救。
Well said, Yuanlong. I'll send my wife and family with it.
元龍之言甚善。吾當並妻小移去。
Song Xian and Wei Xu take his wife, his family and the grain to Xiapi. Lü Bu rides for Xiao Pass with Chen Deng.
遂令宋憲、魏續保護妻小與錢糧移屯下邳；一面自引軍與陳登往救蕭關。
Let me ride ahead to the pass and see how things stand.
容某先到關探曹兵虛實，主公方可行。

x12.title: Three Letters
steps: The General is angry that you won't advance. He's coming to punish you.
溫侯深怪公等不肯向前，要來責罰。
Cao Cao's army is too strong. We should hold the pass, and tell him to guard Xiaopei.
今曹兵勢大，未可輕敵。吾等緊守關隘，可勸主公深保沛城，乃為上策。
That night Chen Deng writes three letters, ties them to arrows, and shoots them down from the pass into Cao Cao's camp.
乘夜連寫三封書，拴在箭上，射下關去。

He tells Lü Bu the bandits on the pass want to hand it over, so attack at dusk, with a fire as the signal. Then he tells Chen Gong Cao's men have taken the back roads and Xuzhou is in danger. Chen Gong abandons the pass. Chen Deng lights the fire.
登飛馬見呂布曰：「關上孫觀等皆欲獻關，將軍可於黃昏時殺去救應。」又逕往報宮曰：「曹兵已抄小路到關內，恐徐州有失。」宮遂引眾棄關而走。登就關上放起火來。
Lü Bu charges in the dark, and his men and Chen Gong's kill each other until dawn.
呂布乘黑殺至，陳宮軍和呂布軍在黑暗裏自相掩殺。

x13.title: Locked Out
steps: At dawn Lü Bu sees the trick, and rides back to Xuzhou. Arrows come down from the wall.
呂布直殺到天明，方知是計；急與陳宮回徐州。到得城邊叫門時，城上亂箭射下。
You stole my lord's city. Now it goes back to him, and you shall not set foot in it again.
汝奪吾主城池，今當仍還吾主，汝不得復入此城也。
Do you still ask after that traitor, General?
將軍尚執迷而問此佞賊乎？

At Xiaopei Cao Cao's flags are already on the walls, and Chen Deng stands among them: I am a servant of the Han. Why would I serve a rebel like you? Zhang Fei falls on them, then Cao Cao himself. Fleeing east, Lü Bu finds the road blocked: Lü Bu, stop! Guan Yunchang is here! He cuts his way through, and reaches Xiapi.
急驅馬至小沛，只見城上盡插曹兵旗號。陳登在城上指布罵曰：「吾乃漢臣，安肯事汝反賊耶！」張飛殺到，曹操又統大軍衝殺前來。布引軍東走，大喝：「呂布休走！關雲長在此！」布殺開條路，逕奔下邳。

x14.title: Chen Gong's Plan
steps: In Xiapi, Lü Bu trusts in his grain and the Si river. Chen Gong urges him to strike Cao Cao before his camp is set. He refuses.
呂布在下邳，自恃糧食足備，且有泗水之險，安心坐守。陳宮曰：「今操兵方來，可乘其寨柵未定，以逸擊勞，無不勝者。」布不聽。
Cao Cao comes under the wall and calls on him to surrender. Chen Gong curses Cao Cao and puts an arrow through his parasol.
操至城下，大叫呂布答話，勸其早降。陳宮在布側大罵曹操奸賊，一箭射中其麾蓋。

Cao Cao has come far, and can't stay long. Take your horse and foot outside and camp there; I'll hold the city. If he attacks you, I strike his back. If he attacks the city, you come to our rescue. In ten days his food is gone, and one blow breaks him. Two positions, like the horns of an ox.
曹操遠來，勢不能久。將軍可以步騎出屯於外，宮將餘眾閉守於內。操若攻將軍，宮引兵擊其背；若來攻城，將軍為救於後。不過旬日，操軍食盡，可一鼓而破，此乃犄角之勢也。
Lü Bu goes home to make ready. It is bitter winter, and he tells his servants to pack plenty of padded clothes.
遂歸府收拾戎裝。時方冬寒，分付從人多帶綿衣。
In her rooms, his wife hears of it.

x15.title: Where Are You Going?
steps: Chen Gong has a plan. I'll camp outside the walls, and he'll hold the city.
陳宮之謀：吾出屯於外，宮閉守於內。
You'd leave the whole city, and your wife and child, and go out alone with your army? If anything happens, will I still be your wife?
君委全城，捐妻子，孤軍遠出，倘一旦有變，妾豈得為將軍之妻乎？
Lü Bu hesitates, and for three days he does not go out.
Cao Cao's army surrounds the city. If you don't go out soon, we'll be trapped. I hear his grain is short and he has sent to Xuchang for more. Take your best men and cut his supply road.
操軍四面圍城，若不早出，必受其困。近聞操軍糧少，遣人往許都去取，早晚將至。將軍可引精兵往斷其糧道。此計大妙。
Lü Bu agrees, and comes in again to tell his wife.
布然其言，復入內對嚴氏說知此事。

If you go out, can Chen Gong and Gao Shun hold the city? If anything goes wrong, it will be too late for regrets. Once before, in Chang'an, you abandoned me. Only because Pang Shu hid me did I ever see you again. Who'd have thought you would leave me again now? You have a great future, General. Don't think of me.
將軍若出，陳宮、高順，安能堅守城池？倘有差失，悔無及矣！妾昔在長安，已為將軍所棄，幸賴龐舒私藏妾身，再得與將軍相聚；孰知今又棄妾而去乎？將軍前程萬里，請勿以妾為念！
She weeps bitterly. Lü Bu, unable to decide, goes in to Diaochan.
言罷痛哭。布聞言愁悶不決，入告貂蟬。
You are my protector, General. Don't ride out alone so lightly.
將軍與妾作主，勿輕騎自出。
Don't worry. I have my halberd and Red Hare. Who would dare come near me?
汝無憂慮。吾有畫戟、赤兔馬，誰敢近我？
He goes out to Chen Gong.
The grain they say is coming is a trick. Cao Cao is full of tricks. I won't move.
操軍糧至者，詐也。操多詭計，吾未敢動。
Chen Gong goes out sighing: we will die with no ground to be buried in.
宮出歎曰：「吾等死無葬身之地矣！」
Lü Bu's envoys get through to Yuan Shu, who answers: Lü Bu breaks his word. Send the girl first, and then I'll send troops.
許汜、王楷至壽春見袁術，術曰：「奉先反覆無信，可先送女，然後發兵。」
Then I'll take her through myself.
At the second watch he wraps his daughter in silk floss, covers her in armour, and ties her on his back.
次夜二更時分，呂布將女以綿纏身，用甲包裹，負於背上。

x16.title: Through the Lines
steps: He takes up his halberd and rides out of the gate.
提戟上馬。放開城門，布當先出城。

Liu Bei's men close in, and Xu Huang and Xu Chu come up behind. Everyone is shouting: Don't let Lü Bu get away! Lü Bu is brave, but there is a girl tied to his back, and he dare not risk her in the press.
玄德自引一軍殺來，後面徐晃、許褚皆殺來，眾軍皆大叫曰：「不要走了呂布！」呂布雖勇，終是縛一女在身上，只恐有傷，不敢衝突重圍。
He turns back into the city, and drinks.
布見軍來太急，只得仍退入城。回到城中，心中憂悶，只是飲酒。

x17.title: The Flood
steps: Two months, and the city has not fallen. Guo Jia's plan: break the dykes of the Yi and the Si. Cao's army waits on high ground and watches Xiapi drown. Only the east gate stays dry.
曹操攻城，兩月不下。郭嘉決沂、泗之水。曹兵皆居高原，坐視水淹下邳。下邳一城，只剩得東門無水；其餘各門，都被水淹。
I have Red Hare. He crosses water as if it were flat ground. What do I have to fear?
吾有赤兔馬，渡水如平地，又何懼哉！
Every day he drinks with his wife and his concubine. Wine and women wear him down.
乃日與妻妾痛飲美酒。因酒色過傷，形容銷減。
One day he picks up a mirror and looks at himself.
Wine and women have ruined me! From today, no more.
吾被酒色傷矣！自今日始，當戒之。
He orders that anyone in the city caught drinking will be beheaded.
遂下令城中，但有飲酒皆斬。

x18.title: Fifty Lashes
steps: Thanks to your fame, General, I've got back my stolen horses. The others brewed a little wine to celebrate. We didn't dare drink it without offering you some first.
託將軍虎威，追得失馬。眾將皆來作賀，釀得些酒，未敢擅飲，特先奉上微意。
I've just banned wine, and you brew it and drink together! Are you plotting against me? Behead him!
吾方禁酒，汝卻釀酒會飲，莫非同謀伐我乎？
The officers beg for him. Fifty lashes across the back, and he is let go. Every officer goes away disheartened.
眾將哀告，打了五十背花，然後放歸。眾將無不喪氣。
That night, at Hou Cheng's house.
宋憲、魏續至侯成家探視。
He only cares for his wife and women. We're dirt to him.
布只戀妻子，視吾等如草芥。
The army's at the walls, the water's at the moat. We'll die any day.
軍圍城下，水遶壕邊，吾等死無日矣！
What he trusts in is Red Hare. If you two will open the gate and take him, I'll steal the horse first and take it to Lord Cao.
布所倚恃者，赤兔馬也。汝二人果能獻門擒布，吾當先盜馬去見曹公。

x19.title: Red Hare
steps: Hou Cheng has slipped into the stables, stolen Red Hare, and ridden for the east gate, the only one still dry.
侯成暗至馬院，盜了那匹赤兔馬，飛奔東門來。
Wei Xu opens the gate to let him out, then makes a show of chasing him.
魏續便開門放出，卻佯作追趕之狀。
In Cao Cao's camp Hou Cheng hands over the horse: Song Xian and Wei Xu will raise a white flag and open the gate. Cao Cao has dozens of placards shot into the city.
侯成到曹操寨，獻上馬匹，備言宋憲、魏續插白旗為號，準備獻門。曹操便押榜數十張射入城去。

At dawn the assault comes. Lü Bu fights on the wall from dawn to noon, then sits down in the gate tower to rest, and falls asleep in his chair. Song Xian takes his halberd first. Then the two of them bind him, rope over rope.
次日平明，曹兵攻城，布親自抵敵。從平明直打到日中，布少憩門樓，不覺睡著在椅上。宋憲先盜其畫戟，便與魏續一齊動手，將呂布繩纏索綁，緊緊縛住。
They wave the white flag. Cao's army pours in. Gao Shun and Zhang Liao are trapped by the water and taken; Chen Gong is caught at the south gate.
把白旗一招，曹兵一擁而入。高順、張遼在西門，水圍難出，為曹兵所擒。陳宮奔至南門，為徐晃所獲。

x20.title: White Gate Tower
steps: Cao Cao has the floodwater drawn off, and sits with Liu Bei on the White Gate Tower. The prisoners are brought up. Lü Bu, huge as he is, is roped into a ball.
曹操入城，即傳令退了所決之水，與玄德同坐白門樓上，關、張侍立於側，提過擒獲一干人來。呂布雖然長大，卻被繩索綑作一團。
The ropes are too tight! Loosen them!
I treated you well. How could you turn on me?
我待諸將不薄，汝等何忍背反？
You listened to your wife and women, and not to your officers. What do you call treating us well?
聽妻妾言，不聽將計，何謂不薄？
Lü Bu says nothing. Gao Shun is brought up. Asked what he has to say, he says nothing, and is beheaded. Then Chen Gong is brought in.
布默然。須臾，眾擁高順至。操問曰：「汝有何言？」順不答。操命斬之。徐晃解陳宮至。
Gongtai. Have you been well, since we parted?
Your heart is crooked. That's why I left you.
My heart is crooked. Then why serve Lü Bu?
吾心不正，公又奈何獨事呂布？
Lü Bu has no judgment, but he isn't treacherous and cunning like you.
布雖無謀，不似你詭詐奸險。
You thought yourself so wise. And now?
公自謂足智多謀，今竟何如？
If only this man had listened to me, he'd not be taken.
恨此人不從吾言！若從吾言，未必被擒也。
Then what is to be done today?
And your old mother, your wife and children?
公如是，奈公之老母妻子何？

I've heard that one who rules by filial duty does not harm another man's parents, and one who rules with kindness does not cut off another's line. Whether they live is up to you. I am taken. Kill me now. I have no regrets.
吾聞以孝治天下者，不害人之親；施仁政於天下者，不絕人之祀。老母妻子之存亡，亦在於明公耳。吾身既被擒，請即就戮，並無挂念。
He walks down the stairs himself, and the guards cannot hold him back. Cao Cao rises, weeping, to see him off. Chen Gong does not look back.
宮逕步下樓，左右牽之不住。操起身泣而送之。宮並不回顧。
Take Gongtai's mother, wife and children to Xuchang, and care for them as long as they live. Whoever neglects them dies.
即送公臺老母妻子回許都養老。怠慢者斬。
Chen Gong hears it, says nothing, and stretches out his neck for the blade.
宮聞言，亦不開口，伸頸就刑。眾皆下淚。
You sit above as a guest, and I stand below a prisoner. Won't you say one word for me?
公為坐上客，布為階下囚，何不發一言而相寬乎？
What you feared was me, and I submit. You lead, I'll be your second, and the realm is easily won.
明公所患，不過於布。布今已服矣。公為大將，布副之，天下不難定也。
Have you forgotten Ding Jianyang and Dong Zhuo?
公不見丁建陽、董卓之事乎？
You, of all men, are the one who can't be trusted!
Cao Cao orders him taken down and strangled.
Big Ears! Have you forgotten the halberd at the camp gate?
大耳兒！不記轅門射戟時耶？
Lü Bu, you coward! If you die, you die. What is there to be afraid of?
呂布匹夫！死則死耳，何懼之有！
Lü Bu is strangled, and his head is hung up.
操令將呂布縊死，然後梟首。
We met in Puyang. How could you forget?
濮陽城中曾相遇，如何忘卻？
Only a pity the fire wasn't bigger. It didn't burn you to death, traitor!
只是可惜！可惜當日火不大，不曾燒死你這國賊！

Cao Cao draws his sword to kill Zhang Liao himself. Zhang Liao stretches out his neck without fear. Then someone behind Cao Cao catches his arm, and someone else kneels in front of him: Do not strike, Chancellor!
操拔劍在手，親自來殺張遼。遼全無懼色，引頸待殺。曹操背後一人攀住臂膊，一人跪於面前，說道：「丞相且莫動手！」
Lü Bu begged for mercy, and no one saved him. Zhang Liao cursed the traitor, and lived. Who saved Zhang Liao? Hear the next chapter.
乞哀呂布無人救，罵賊張遼反得生。畢竟救張遼的是誰，且看下文分解。

opening: Dong Zhuo is dead, and Lü Bu, who killed him, holds Chang'an with Minister Wang Yun. But Dong Zhuo's old generals, Li Jue and Guo Si, are marching on the city.
You are Lady Yan, Lü Bu's wife: his first and principal wife, married long before Diaochan came to him as his concubine. With you is your daughter, Lü Bu's only child.
董卓既誅，呂布與王司徒共掌長安。董卓舊將李傕、郭汜，引兵殺奔長安來。
你是嚴氏，呂布的正妻。呂布先娶嚴氏為正妻，後娶貂蟬為妾。你身邊是女兒，呂布唯一的孩子。

dilemma.open: He has abandoned me. Keep still, and keep the child still.
dilemma.open_zh: 將軍已棄我而去。不要出聲，也別讓孩子出聲。

dilemma.open: His brothers glare at me. Liu Bei is the one who matters. Make him family.
dilemma.open_zh: 他兩個兄弟怒目而視。要緊的是玄德。與他結為一家。

dilemma.open: Cao Bao is on the wall. One word in the dark, and the gate swings open.
dilemma.open_zh: 曹豹在城上。暗中一句話，城門便開。

dilemma.q: Hit the halberd at a hundred and fifty paces.
dilemma.open: Two armies are waiting on one arrow. Heaven decides, they think. My hand decides.
dilemma.q_zh: 一百五十步外，射中畫戟小枝。
dilemma.open_zh: 兩家兵馬，都等這一箭。他們以為是天意。其實是我的手。

dilemma.open: Yuan Shu may be emperor any day. And he has only one son.
dilemma.slip: Not so fast. Think of her.
dilemma.open_zh: 袁術早晚為天子，又只有一子。

dilemma.open: Thirty li start, and drums to follow. They mustn't reach the border.
dilemma.open_zh: 他們先走了三十里，鼓樂聲還聽得見。不能讓他們出境。

dilemma.open: A post rider in a hurry, on the road to Xiaopei. Take the side path and cut him off.
dilemma.slip: He's getting away. The side path.
dilemma.open_zh: 官道上驛馬飛奔，往小沛去。走小路截住他。

dilemma.q: Get the letters down to Cao's camp unseen.
dilemma.open: Chen Gong is on the pass, and he trusts no one. Three arrows, in the dark.
dilemma.open_zh: 陳宮在關上，誰也不信。三枝箭，趁黑。

dilemma.open: Two positions, the city and the camp. Cao Cao can't fight both. If only he'd listen.
dilemma.open_zh: 城內城外，互為犄角。曹操兩頭難顧。只要他肯聽。

dilemma.open: He means to leave the city, and me in it. Ask him where he's going.
dilemma.open_zh: 他要出城，把我留在城裏。問他要去哪裏。

dilemma.open: Chen Gong has talked him round again. Remind him of Chang'an.
dilemma.open_zh: 陳宮又說動他了。提一提長安。

dilemma.open: He has come to me. One sentence.
dilemma.open_zh: 他來問我了。只說一句。

dilemma.q: Get Red Hare out by the east gate unseen.
dilemma.open: Everything he trusts is under me now. Across the water, past the guards, to the one dry gate.
dilemma.slip: A guard. Back into the dark.
dilemma.open_zh: 他所倚恃的，如今在我胯下。涉水過去，避開守卒，直奔唯一的旱門。

dilemma.open: He left me at the inn, and I never forgot it. Give him a reason to live.
dilemma.open_zh: 當年客店一別，我從未忘記。給他一個活下去的理由。

dilemma.open: The best fighter alive, offering to serve. Ask the man beside me.
dilemma.open_zh: 天下第一的猛將，願為我用。問問身邊這個人。

dilemma.q: Kill Zhang Liao with your own sword.
dilemma.open: He wished the fire at Puyang had burned me, and calls me traitor to my face. He doesn't flinch.
dilemma.open_zh: 他恨濮陽的火沒燒死我，當面罵我國賊。他面不改色。

worlds.name: Three Silk Pouches
couplets: 吳國太佛寺看新郎　劉皇叔洞房續佳偶
Lady Wu sees the groom at the temple; the Imperial Uncle takes a new bride
玄德智激孫夫人　孔明二氣周公瑾
Xuande wins Lady Sun over; Kongming angers Zhou Yu a second time

pouch1.name: The first silk pouch
pouch1.plan: Go first to Qiao Guolao, father of the two Qiao sisters. Let the five hundred dress in red, buy what a wedding needs, and let the whole city know Liu Bei has come to marry.
pouch1.plan_zh: 先去拜见乔国老。五百军士披红挂彩，进城采办婚礼用品，让全城都知道刘备来东吴成亲。

pouch2.name: The second silk pouch
pouch2.plan: Go to your lord in alarm: Cao Cao has raised five hundred thousand men to avenge Red Cliffs, and Jingzhou is in danger. He must come home.
pouch2.plan_zh: 装作大惊，去见主公：曹操起兵五十万，要报赤壁之仇，荆州危急，请主公立刻回去。

pouch3.name: The third silk pouch
pouch3.opens: Open when there is no way out.
pouch3.opens_zh: 走投无路的时候再打开。
pouch3.plan: Let our lord tell his wife everything, and ask her to save him.
pouch3.plan_zh: 请主公把实情全部告诉夫人，求夫人解围。

s1.title: The Bait
steps: Chaisang, after Red Cliffs. Lu Su is back from Jingzhou with one sheet of paper: Liu Bei will borrow Jingzhou, and give it back when he has taken the west.
赤壁之战以后，柴桑。鲁肃从荆州回来，只带回一纸文书：刘备说先借荆州，等取了西川再还。
You've fallen for Zhuge Liang's trick! He calls it borrowing, and means to keep it. When he has taken the west? If that takes ten years, he keeps it ten years?
子敬，你中了诸葛亮的计了！说是借，其实是赖着不还。他说取了西川就还，要是十年取不下西川，就十年不还吗？
A few days later his spies come back from across the river: white banners hang in Jingzhou, and there is a new grave outside the walls. Liu Bei's wife, Lady Gan, has died.
过了几天，探子回报：荆州城里挂起了白幡，城外新起了一座坟。刘备的夫人甘夫人去世了。
Then my plan is made. Liu Bei will put his own hands in the rope, and Jingzhou is ours.
我的计策成了。叫刘备自己束手就擒，荆州易如反掌！
A man who loses his wife marries again. Our lord has a sister. She is fierce and brave, with hundreds of maids, and they all wear blades. Her rooms are hung with weapons. No man could match her.
刘备死了妻子，一定会再娶。主公有个妹妹，性子极其刚烈勇猛，身边几百个侍女，平时都带着刀，房里摆满了兵器，男人都比不上她。
We send a matchmaker and invite him to Wu to marry her. Once he's in Nanxu, he gets no wife. He gets a cell. Then we trade him for Jingzhou.
派人去荆州做媒，请刘备到东吴来入赘。等把他骗到南徐，妻子娶不到，就把他关进牢里，再派人去拿他换荆州。
Zhou Yu writes to Sun Quan. Sun Quan reads the letter, smiles to himself, and sends Lü Fan to Jingzhou as matchmaker.
周瑜写信给孙权。孙权看了，暗暗高兴，派吕范去荆州做媒。

s2.title: Three Silk Pouches
steps: Since Lady Gan died, Liu Bei has grieved day and night. Word comes: Wu has sent an envoy, Lü Fan.
甘夫人去世以后，刘备日夜烦恼。这天有人来报：东吴派吕范来了。
That's Zhou Yu's scheme, and it's about Jingzhou. I'll listen behind the screen. Whatever he says, my lord, agree to it.
这是周瑜的计策，一定是为了荆州。我就在屏风后面偷听。他说什么，主公都答应下来。
I hear you've lost your wife, Imperial Uncle. I have a good match for you, so I've come as matchmaker.
听说皇叔丧偶，我这里有一门好亲事，所以不避嫌疑，特来做媒。
To lose a wife in middle age is a great misfortune. She is hardly cold. How can I talk of marrying?
中年丧妻，是大不幸。她尸骨未寒，我怎么忍心谈亲事？

A man with no wife is a house with no ridge-beam. My lord the Marquis has a sister, beautiful and good. If our houses are joined, Cao Cao won't dare look south. But the Dowager loves her youngest dearly and won't send her far. You must come to Wu to marry.
人没有妻子，就像房子没有大梁。我家吴侯有个妹妹，又美又贤惠。两家结了亲，曹贼就不敢正眼看东南了。只是国太吴夫人最疼小女儿，不肯远嫁，一定要皇叔到东吴去成亲。
I'm nearly fifty, and my hair is grey. The Marquis's sister is young. We're no match.
我年近半百，头发都白了。吴侯的妹妹正当妙龄，恐怕不般配。
She's a woman, but her spirit beats any man's. She always says: if he isn't a hero of the realm, I won't marry him. Your name is known everywhere. Why worry about age?
她虽是女子，志气胜过男儿。她常说：不是天下英雄，我不嫁。皇叔名满天下，正是淑女配君子，何必在乎年纪？
Agree to it. Zhou Yu can scheme all he likes; he won't get half a move past me. The Marquis's sister will be yours, and Jingzhou won't be lost.
答应他。周瑜虽然会用计，怎么算得过我诸葛亮？略施小计，叫周瑜半步也施展不开。吴侯的妹妹归主公，荆州也万无一失。
Zhou Yu means to kill me. How can I walk into that?
周瑜设计要害我，我怎么能自己往危险里走？
Liu Bei still doubts. Zhuge Liang calls Zhao Yun over and speaks into his ear.
刘备还是拿不定主意。诸葛亮把赵云叫到跟前，附耳说道：
Guard our lord into Wu, and take these three silk pouches. There is a plan in each. Open them in order.
你保护主公去东吴，带上这三个锦囊。里面有三条妙计，依次去做。
Zhao Yun hides them against his skin.
赵云把三个锦囊贴身藏好。
Winter, the tenth month. Ten fast boats and five hundred men leave Jingzhou for Nanxu. Liu Bei goes aboard uneasy.
建安十四年冬十月，刘备和赵云、孙乾带着十只快船、五百多人，离开荆州，往南徐去。刘备心里一直不安。

s3.title: The First Pouch
steps: The Directing General said: three plans, in order. We're here. Time to open the first.
军师吩咐三条妙计，依次而行。现在已经到了，该先打开第一个锦囊。
The first plan: go to Qiao Guolao. Dress the men in red, buy for a wedding, and let the whole city know. Zhou Yu wants a prisoner nobody hears of. Give him a wedding everybody hears of.
第一条妙计：先拜见乔国老；军士披红挂彩，采办婚礼用品，让全城都知道。周瑜想要一个没人知道的囚犯，那就给他一场人人都知道的婚事。
Zhao Yun calls the five hundred together and gives each man his orders.
赵云把五百随行军士叫来，一一吩咐。
The five hundred put on red and go into the city to buy what a wedding needs, telling everyone they meet: Liu Bei has come to marry into Wu.
五百军士都披红挂彩，进城采办婚礼用品，逢人就说：刘备来东吴入赘了。
Qiao Guolao, father of the two Qiao sisters, lives here in Nanxu.
乔国老是大乔、小乔的父亲，就住在南徐。

s4.title: Whose Daughter?
steps: Your daughter is promised to Liu Xuande, and he's already here. Why keep it from me?
令爱已经许给刘玄德做夫人了，玄德已经到了，为什么还瞒着我？

She sends for Sun Quan, and sends people into the city to ask. They all come back with the same story: the groom is at the guesthouse, and his five hundred men are buying pigs, sheep and fruit for the wedding.
国太派人去请吴侯，又派人到城里打听。回来的人都说：确有此事，女婿已经在驿馆住下，五百随从正在城里买猪羊果品，准备成亲。
Sun Quan comes in. His mother beats her breast and weeps.
孙权进后堂见母亲，国太捶胸大哭。
You treat me as if I didn't exist! A son asks his mother before he marries off her daughter. You've made Liu Xuande your brother-in-law and hid it from me? She's my daughter!
你简直把我当成不存在！男大当婚，女大当嫁，这是常理。我是你母亲，这种事应该先问我。你招刘玄德做女婿，为什么瞒着我？女儿是我的！
If you don't want it known, don't do it! The whole city knows, and you hide it from me!
要想人不知，除非己莫为！满城百姓谁不知道？就瞒着我一个！
It isn't real. It's Zhou Yu's plan: lure Liu Bei here and hold him until he gives up Jingzhou. If he won't, we kill him. It's a stratagem, not a marriage.
不是真的。这是周瑜的计策，为了取荆州，拿这件事做幌子，把刘备骗来关起来，叫他拿荆州来换；他要是不肯，就先杀了他。这是计，不是真心。

Grand Commander of six commanderies and eighty-one districts, and he can't think how to take Jingzhou except by using my daughter as bait! Kill Liu Bei, and my girl is a widow before she's a wife. Who will marry her then? You'll ruin her whole life!
他做了六郡八十一州的大都督，竟想不出别的计策取荆州，却拿我女儿的名义使美人计！杀了刘备，我女儿就成了望门寡，以后还怎么说亲？这不是误了她一辈子吗！
Even if it won Jingzhou, the realm would laugh at you. Liu Bei is of the Han royal house. Better make him your son-in-law in earnest, and spare yourselves the shame.
就算用这计得了荆州，也要被天下人耻笑。刘皇叔是汉室宗亲，不如真的招他做女婿，免得出丑。
I've never met him. Tomorrow I'll see him at Sweet Dew Temple. If I don't like him, do as you please. If I do, I'll give him my daughter myself.
我没见过刘皇叔。明天约他在甘露寺见面。不中我的意，随你们怎么办；要是中我的意，我自己把女儿嫁给他。
Have Jia Hua hide three hundred axemen in the side halls. If the Dowager isn't pleased, one signal, and they take him.
不如让贾华带三百刀斧手埋伏在两边廊下。国太要是不喜欢，一声令下，两边一齐冲出，把他拿下。
Sun Quan agrees, and sends for Jia Hua.
孙权就叫贾华预先准备，只看国太的意思行事。
Qiao Guolao sends word to Liu Bei: tomorrow the Marquis and the Dowager will see you. Be careful.
乔国老派人告诉刘备：明天吴侯和国太要亲自见你，千万小心。
Zhao Yun says: tomorrow's meeting means more harm than good. He will bring the five hundred himself.
赵云说：明天这次见面，凶多吉少，他要亲自带五百军士保护。

s5_wait.title: Sweet Dew Temple
steps: Not yet. Something's wrong in those side rooms. I'll search every corridor before my lord sits down.
还不行。两边厢房不对劲。主公入座之前，我要把每条走廊都查一遍。

s5.title: Sweet Dew Temple
steps: Lady Wu and Qiao Guolao are already seated in the abbot's hall. Liu Bei wears fine armour under his brocade robe. Zhao Yun, in full armour, has brought the five hundred.
吴国太和乔国老已经在甘露寺方丈里坐好。刘备里面穿着细甲，外面罩着锦袍。赵云全身披挂，带着五百军士跟来。
Sun Quan sees Liu Bei's bearing, and feels a touch of fear.
孙权见刘备仪表不凡，心里有些畏惧。
Xuande has the bearing of a dragon, and his kindness is known everywhere. You've found a fine son-in-law, Madam.
玄德有龙凤之姿，仁德又传遍天下。国太得了这样的好女婿，真是可喜可贺。
Not the one who carried A Dou out at Changban?
莫非就是在当阳长坂坡抱着阿斗杀出来的那位？
Just now I walked the corridors. There are axemen hidden in the side rooms. They mean you harm. Tell the Dowager.
刚才我在廊下巡视，看见房里埋伏着刀斧手，一定没安好心。可以告诉国太。
Liu Bei kneels before Lady Wu's seat, weeping.
刘备跪在国太席前，哭着说：
If you mean to kill me, kill me here.
如果要杀刘备，就在这里杀吧。
There are axemen hidden in the corridors. Who are they for, if not me?
廊下埋伏着刀斧手，不是要杀我，又是要做什么？
Xuande is my son-in-law today, so he's my own child. Why are there axemen in the corridors?
今天玄德已经是我的女婿，就是我的儿女。为什么在廊下埋伏刀斧手？
Sun Quan says he knew nothing, and blames Lü Fan. Lü Fan blames Jia Hua. Jia Hua says nothing. Lady Wu orders him beheaded.
孙权推说不知道，叫吕范来问。吕范推给贾华。国太叫来贾华责骂，贾华一句话也说不出。国太下令把他斩了。
To behead a general would bode ill for the marriage. I could never stay long at your side.
斩了大将，对亲事不吉利。我也难以长久留在您身边了。
Qiao Guolao pleads too, and Lady Wu sends Jia Hua away. The axemen run off with their hands over their heads.
乔国老也来劝，国太这才把贾华喝退。刀斧手们抱着头逃走了。

s6.title: The Stone
steps: Liu Bei goes out to change his clothes, and sees a great rock in the courtyard. He draws his attendant's sword and looks up to heaven.
刘备出来更衣，看见院子里有一块大石头。他拔出随从佩带的剑，仰天祷告：
If I'm to get home to Jingzhou and build a kingdom, let one stroke cut this stone in two. If I'm to die here, let the sword not cut it.
如果我刘备能回到荆州，成就王霸之业，就一剑把这石头劈成两半。如果我要死在这里，就让剑砍不开石头。
The sword falls, sparks fly, and the stone splits in two.
手起剑落，火星四溅，石头劈成了两半。
Why do you hate this stone so, Xuande?
玄德公为什么这么恨这块石头？

I'm nearly fifty and haven't rid the realm of traitors. Now the Dowager makes me her son-in-law, the chance of a lifetime. I asked heaven: if I'm to break Cao Cao and restore the Han, let the stone split. And it did.
我年近五十，还没能为国家除掉奸贼，心里常常恨自己。现在承蒙国太招我做女婿，这是一生难得的机遇。刚才我问天占卜：如果能破曹兴汉，就砍断这块石头。果然砍断了。
Sun Quan thinks: is he lying to me?
孙权心里想：刘备莫非是拿这话骗我？
I'll ask heaven too. If I'm to break Cao Cao, let this stone split as well.
我也来问天占卜：如果能破曹贼，也砍断这块石头。
But under his breath he prays: if I'm to take Jingzhou back and make Wu great, split in two!
可他心里暗暗祷告：如果能再夺回荆州，兴旺东吴，就把石头砍成两半！
The sword falls, and the stone splits again, crosswise. The stone with the cross cut in it is there to this day.
手起剑落，大石头又裂开了。到今天，那块带十字纹的石头还在。
They drop their swords and go back in hand in hand. After a few more cups, the two stand outside the temple and look out over the river.
两人扔下剑，手拉手回到席上。又喝了几巡酒，两人一起站在寺前，观赏江山景色。
This is the finest view in the realm!
The wind lifts the river into white waves. A small boat runs over them as if on flat ground.
江风浩荡，白浪滔天。忽然看见一只小船在浪上行驶，就像走在平地上一样。
'Southerners sail boats, northerners ride horses.' It's true.
“南人驾船，北人骑马”，果然不假。
Sun Quan takes it as a jibe that he can't ride. He calls for a horse, gallops down the slope and back up again.
孙权以为刘备笑他不会骑马，叫人牵过马来，飞身上马，冲下山坡，又扬鞭跑了上来。
Liu Bei lifts his robe, leaps onto a horse, gallops down and back up. The two rein in side by side on the slope and laugh. It is still called Rein-In Slope.
刘备撩起衣襟，一跃上马，飞驰下山，又跑了上来。两人并马站在山坡上，扬鞭大笑。这地方到今天还叫“驻马坡”。

s7.title: Blades in the Bridal Room
steps: Liu Bei tells Qiao Guolao that many in Wu want him dead. Lady Wu is furious. My son-in-law: who dares harm him? She moves him into her own household, Zhao Yun and the men with him. Within days there is a great feast, and Lady Sun and Liu Bei are married.
刘备对乔国老说，江东有很多人想害他。国太大怒：“我的女婿，谁敢害他！”当即叫他搬进府里住，赵云和军士也一起搬进来。没过几天，大摆筵席，孙夫人和刘备成亲。
When the guests have gone, two rows of red candles lead Liu Bei to the bridal room.
客人散去以后，两行红烛把刘备引到洞房门口。
Spears and blades everywhere in the lamplight, and the maids on either side with swords at their hips. Liu Bei's soul nearly leaves his body.
灯光下满屋刀枪，侍女们个个佩剑挂刀，站在两边。刘备吓得魂不附体。
Don't be afraid, sir. My lady has loved martial things since she was small. She has her maids fence for fun. That's all this is.
贵人不要害怕。夫人从小喜欢看武艺，平时常叫侍女们击剑取乐，所以才这样。
That's no sight for a bride. It chills me. Have them take it away, for now.
这不是夫人该看的东西，我心里发冷，叫她们暂时撤了吧。
The matron tells Lady Sun. Lady Sun laughs.
管家婆去禀告孙夫人。孙夫人笑了。
Half a lifetime at war, and he's afraid of weapons?
打了半辈子仗，还怕兵器吗？

She has every weapon taken out, and the maids unbuckle their swords. That night they are married, and both are glad of it. Liu Bei sends Sun Qian home to Jingzhou with the good news. The trap has become a marriage.
她叫人把兵器全部撤走，侍女们也解下剑来伺候。当晚两人成亲，十分和美。刘备先让孙乾回荆州报喜。圈套，变成了一门真亲事。

s8.title: The Gilded Cage
steps: Sun Quan has written to Zhou Yu: Mother has married my sister to Liu Bei in earnest. The fake has come true. What now? Zhou Yu's answer comes back sealed.
孙权派人到柴桑告诉周瑜：母亲做主，已经把妹妹嫁给刘备了，没想到弄假成真，现在怎么办？周瑜回了一封密信。

He writes: then hold him softly in Wu. Build him palaces to sap his will. Send him beauties and treasures to fill his eyes and ears. Part him from Guan Yu and Zhang Fei, keep him far from Zhuge Liang, then strike. Let him go now, and the dragon finds its clouds and rain. He'll never stay in a pond.
他说：那就把他软困在吴中，给他大修宫室，消磨他的志气；多送美女和珍玩，让他耳目享乐。使他和关羽、张飞疏远，和诸葛亮隔开，然后再出兵，大事可定。现在要是放了他，就像蛟龙得了云雨，终究不是池中之物。
Gongjin's plan is just what I think. Liu Bei has never known wealth. Give him halls and gold and women, and he'll drift away from Zhuge Liang, Guan and Zhang. Then Jingzhou can be had.
公瑾的计策正合我意。刘备出身低微，四处奔走，从没享受过富贵。现在给他华堂大厦、美女金帛，他自然会疏远孔明、关羽、张飞。到那时，荆州就可以拿下了。

Sun Quan has the east palace done up, planted with flowers and trees, filled with fine things and dozens of women musicians, and invites Liu Bei and his sister to live there. Lady Wu thinks her son means well. And Liu Bei, dazzled, forgets Jingzhou altogether.
孙权当天就整修东府，广栽花木，摆满器用，又添了几十个女乐和许多金玉锦缎，请刘备和妹妹搬进去住。国太只当孙权是好意，高兴得不得了。刘备果然被声色迷住，一点也不想回荆州了。

s9.title: Year's End
steps: Zhao Yun and the five hundred are quartered outside the east palace. Day after day there's nothing to do but ride and shoot outside the walls. The year is nearly over.
赵云和五百军士住在东府前面，整天无事，只到城外射箭跑马。眼看一年快过完了。

The Directing General said: open the first on reaching Nanxu, the second at the year's end, the third when we're in danger with no way out. The year is ending, and my lord, lost in pleasure, won't even see me. Time for the second.
军师给我三个锦囊，吩咐我：一到南徐，开第一个；住到年底，开第二个；遇到危急、走投无路的时候，开第三个。现在年快过完了，主公贪恋女色，连面都不见，为什么不拆开第二个锦囊，照计行事？
The second plan: go to Liu Bei in alarm, with news that Cao Cao is marching on Jingzhou. Zhou Yu wants him to forget Jingzhou. Make him remember it.
第二条妙计：装作大惊，去报主公，说曹操大军杀向荆州。周瑜想让他忘了荆州，那就让他想起来。

s10.title: Don't Lie to Me
steps: A maid announces: Zhao Zilong has urgent news.
侍女通报：赵子龙有紧急的事来报。
My lord, shut away in your painted halls, have you forgotten Jingzhou?
主公深居画堂，难道不想荆州了吗？
有什么事这样大惊小怪？
This morning the Directing General sent word: Cao Cao has raised five hundred thousand men to avenge Red Cliffs, and is marching on Jingzhou. It's desperate. Come home, my lord.
今天早上军师派人来报，说曹操要报赤壁之仇，起了五十万精兵杀到荆州，情况十分危急，请主公赶快回去。
I must talk it over with my wife.
If you ask her, she won't let you go. Better not tell her. Leave tonight. Wait, and it's too late.
要是和夫人商量，她一定不肯放主公回去。不如不说，今晚就动身。晚了就误事了。
Go for now. I'll see to it.
Liu Bei goes in to Lady Sun, quietly weeping.
刘备进去见孙夫人，暗暗流泪。
I've drifted far from home. I can't serve my parents or sacrifice to my ancestors. That's a great failing in a son. The New Year is close, and it weighs on me.
我一个人漂泊在外乡，活着不能侍奉父母，又不能祭祀祖宗，实在是大不孝。眼看新年就要到了，心里闷闷不乐。
Don't lie to me. I've already heard. Zhao Zilong just told you Jingzhou is in danger, and you want to go home. That's why you're talking like this.
你别瞒我了，我已经听说了。刚才赵子龙来报荆州危急，你想回去，所以才找这个借口。
Since you know, how can I hide it? If I don't go and Jingzhou falls, the realm will laugh at me. If I go, I must leave you. That's why I'm troubled.
夫人既然知道了，我怎么敢再瞒？我要是不去，荆州有失，会被天下人耻笑；要是去，又舍不得夫人。所以才烦恼。
I'm your wife now. Wherever you go, I go with you.
我已经嫁给你了，你去哪里，我就跟到哪里。
You mean it, but will the Dowager and the Marquis ever let you go? If you pity me, let us part for a while.
夫人的心意虽然如此，可国太和吴侯怎么肯放夫人走？夫人如果可怜我，就暂时分别吧。
Don't grieve, husband. I'll plead with my mother. She'll let me go with you.
夫君别难过。我去苦求母亲，她一定会放我和你一起走。
Even if the Dowager agrees, the Marquis will stop us.
就算国太答应，吴侯也一定会阻拦。
Lady Sun thinks for a long time.
On New Year's Day, when we go to pay our respects, we'll say we're going to the riverbank to make offerings to your ancestors. And we go, without a word. What do you say?
大年初一我和你去拜年的时候，就说要到江边祭祖，不辞而别。你看怎么样？
If you'll do that, I won't forget it, alive or dead. Don't let it slip.
要是这样，我生死都不会忘记夫人。千万别泄露出去。
Liu Bei sends for Zhao Yun in secret: on New Year's Day, take the men out of the city first, and wait on the high road.
刘备暗中吩咐赵云：大年初一，你先带军士出城，在官道上等候。我借口祭祖，和夫人一起走。

s11.title: New Year's Day
steps: New Year's Day. The Marquis holds a great gathering of his officers in the hall. Lady Sun and Liu Bei go in to pay their respects to Lady Wu.
建安十五年正月初一，吴侯在大堂上大会文武。孙夫人和刘备进去拜见国太。

My husband's parents and ancestors are buried far away in Zhuo, and he grieves for them day and night. Today he'd like to go to the riverbank and make offerings facing north. I've come to tell you, Mother.
夫君想念父母祖宗，坟墓都在涿郡，日夜伤心。今天想到江边去，向北遥祭，特来禀告母亲。
That's a son's duty. Of course you may. You never knew his parents, but go with your husband and make the offerings. That's a wife's part too.
这是孝道，哪有不答应的？你虽然没见过公婆，也可以和你丈夫一起去祭拜，这也是做媳妇的礼数。

They thank her and go out. Only Sun Quan doesn't know. Lady Sun rides in her carriage, taking only what she can carry. Liu Bei rides with a few men. Outside the city Zhao Yun is waiting, and the five hundred close round them.
两人拜谢出来，这时只瞒着孙权一个人。孙夫人坐上车，只带了随身的细软；刘备骑马，带几个随从出城，和赵云会合。五百军士前后护着，离开南徐，连夜赶路。

s12.title: The Jade Inkstone
steps: That day Sun Quan was dead drunk and carried to bed. When his officers learned of the flight it was already dark, and they couldn't wake him. He wakes at the fifth watch.
那天孙权喝得大醉，被左右扶进后堂。等官员们打听到刘备夫妇逃走，天已经黑了，想报告孙权，他又醉得叫不醒，直到五更才醒。
If this man gets away today, there'll be trouble sooner or later. Go after him at once.
今天让这个人跑了，早晚必生祸乱。赶快去追！
Sun Quan sends Chen Wu and Pan Zhang with five hundred picked men, day and night: catch them and bring them back. Then, in his fury, he smashes the jade inkstone on his desk to powder.
孙权命陈武、潘璋挑五百精兵，不分昼夜，一定要追上抓回来。他恨透了刘备，把桌上的玉砚摔得粉碎。
My lord's rage reaches the sky, but Chen Wu and Pan Zhang won't catch them.
主公空有冲天的怒气。我料定陈武、潘璋抓不住他。
The princess has loved martial things since she was a child. She's stern and upright, and every general fears her. If she's gone with Liu Bei of her own will, which of them will lay a hand on her?
郡主从小喜欢武事，严厉刚正，将领们都怕她。她既然愿意跟刘备，一定是同心而去。追去的将领见了郡主，怎么敢下手？
Jiang Qin, Zhou Tai! Take this sword. Bring me my sister's head, and Liu Bei's! Whoever disobeys dies!
蒋钦、周泰！你们两个拿这口剑去，把我妹妹和刘备的头取来！违令的立刻斩首！
Jiang Qin and Zhou Tai ride after them with three thousand men.
蒋钦、周泰领命，带三千兵马随后追来。

s13.title: The Road Block
steps: They ride day and night, rest two watches, and hurry on. Near the border of Chaisang, dust rises behind them. The pursuers!
一行人日夜赶路，夜里只歇了两个更次，又慌忙上路。快到柴桑边界时，后面尘土大起，有人报：追兵来了！
The pursuers are here. What do we do?
Go ahead, my lord. I'll hold the rear.
Liu Bei, get down and be bound! On Grand Commander Zhou's orders, we've been waiting for you!
刘备快下马受缚！我们奉周都督将令，在这里等候多时了！
Zhou Yu, afraid Liu Bei might slip away, had posted Xu Sheng and Ding Feng with three thousand men on this road long before.
原来周瑜怕刘备逃走，早派徐盛、丁奉带三千兵马在要道扎营等候。
Blocked ahead, pursued behind. There's no way out!
前面有拦截的兵，后面有追赶的兵，前后无路，怎么办？
Don't panic, my lord. Two of the Directing General's pouches are opened, and both came true. The third is for when we're in danger. Now's the time.
主公别慌。军师的妙计都在锦囊里，已经拆了两个，都应验了。还有第三个，吩咐遇到危难时才能拆看。今天情况危急，该拆开了。
The third plan: tell Lady Sun everything, and ask her to save them. Zhou Yu's soldiers hold the road. Only the Marquis's sister can open it.
第三条妙计：把实情全部告诉孙夫人，求她解围。周瑜的兵把住了大路，只有吴侯的妹妹才能让他们让开。
Liu Bei reads it, and goes straight to Lady Sun's carriage, weeping.
刘备看了，急忙来到车前，哭着对孙夫人说：
There's something in my heart I must tell you now, all of it.
我有心里话，到了这时候，要全部实说。
夫君有什么话，照实对我说。

The Marquis and Zhou Yu plotted to marry you to me, not for your sake, but to hold me prisoner and take Jingzhou. Once they had it, they'd kill me. You were the bait on their hook. I came anyway, not fearing death, because I knew you had a man's heart and would pity me. When I heard the Marquis meant to harm me, I used Jingzhou's danger to plan our way home. You didn't abandon me, and here we are. Now his men chase us from behind, and Zhou Yu's block us ahead. Only you can save us. If you won't, I'll die here before your carriage.
当初吴侯和周瑜合谋，把夫人嫁给我，其实不是为夫人着想，而是想把我关起来，夺取荆州。夺了荆州，一定会杀我。他们是拿夫人做香饵来钓我。我不怕死，还是来了，是因为知道夫人有男子汉的胸襟，一定会可怜我。前些天听说吴侯要害我，所以借荆州有难，想办法回去。幸好夫人不嫌弃，跟我一起到了这里。现在吴侯派人在后面追，周瑜派人在前面拦，除了夫人，没人能解这场祸。夫人要是不答应，我就死在车前，报答夫人的恩情。
If my brother won't count me his own flesh and blood, how can I ever face him again? Today's danger, I'll settle myself.
我哥哥既然不把我当亲骨肉，我还有什么脸再见他！今天的危难，我自己来解决。

s14.title: Are You in Revolt?
steps: She has the carriage pushed straight forward, rolls up the curtain, and calls out to Xu Sheng and Ding Feng herself.
她喝令随从推车直往前走，卷起车帘，亲自喝问徐盛、丁奉：
The two generals leap from their horses and throw down their weapons.
徐盛、丁奉慌忙下马，扔下兵器，在车前行礼。
How would we dare! We're here on Grand Commander Zhou's orders, waiting for Liu Bei.
我们怎么敢造反！只是奉周都督将令，在这里专等刘备。

Zhou Yu, that traitor! Wu has never wronged him! Xuande is the Emperor's uncle, and my husband. I've told my mother and brother we're going back to Jingzhou. And you bring soldiers to block the road under a hill. Do you mean to rob us?
周瑜这个逆贼！我们东吴哪里亏待过他！玄德是大汉皇叔，是我的丈夫。我已经告诉母亲和哥哥，回荆州去。你们两个带兵在山脚下拦路，是想抢劫我们夫妻的财物吗？
We wouldn't dare. Please calm yourself, madam. It's nothing to do with us. These are the Grand Commander's orders.
不敢不敢，请夫人息怒。这不关我们的事，是周都督的将令。
You fear Zhou Yu, and not me? If Zhou Yu can kill you, can't I kill Zhou Yu?
你们只怕周瑜，就不怕我？周瑜杀得了你们，我就杀不了周瑜吗？

She curses Zhou Yu up and down, and orders the carriage on. The two generals think: we're only servants; how can we cross her? And Zhao Yun's face is thunder. They call off their men and open the road.
她把周瑜大骂一场，喝令推车前进。徐盛、丁奉心想：我们是下人，怎么敢违抗夫人？又见赵云满脸怒气，只好喝住兵马，让开大路。
Five or six li on, shouting rises behind them again.
刚走了五六里，背后喊声又起。
More pursuers. What do we do?
后面追兵又到了，怎么办？
Husband, go on ahead. Zilong and I will hold the rear.
夫君先走，我和子龙断后。
Liu Bei goes on toward the river with three hundred men. Zhao Yun reins in beside the carriage and draws up the rest.
刘备先带三百军士往江边去了。赵云勒马守在车旁，把士兵摆开，专等来将。

s15.title: The Rearguard
steps: Chen Wu and Pan Zhang have joined Xu Sheng and Ding Feng. When the four generals see Lady Sun, they have to dismount, and stand with their hands clasped.
陈武、潘璋已经和徐盛、丁奉合兵一处。四员将领见了孙夫人，只得下马，拱手站着。
Chen Wu, Pan Zhang. What are you doing here?
陈武、潘璋，你们来干什么？
On our lord's orders: to ask you and Xuande to come back.
奉主公之命，请夫人和玄德回去。

It's you rabble who set my brother and me against each other! I'm married. I'm going home with my husband, not running off with a lover. My mother gave her blessing for us to go back to Jingzhou. Even if my brother came himself, he'd have to do it properly. Will you use your soldiers to kill me?
都是你们这帮匹夫，挑拨我们兄妹不和！我已经嫁人了，今天回去，又不是跟人私奔。我是奉了母亲的慈命，让我们夫妻回荆州。就是我哥哥亲自来，也得按礼行事。你们仗着兵威，是想杀害我吗？

The four look at one another, each thinking: whatever happens, they'll always be brother and sister, and the Dowager is behind her. The Marquis is a dutiful son; he'd never go against his mother. Tomorrow he'd turn round and blame us. Better to do her a kindness.
四个人面面相觑，各自心想：他们一万年也还是兄妹，何况有国太做主；吴侯是大孝子，怎么敢违背母亲的话？明天翻过脸来，只会怪我们。不如做个人情。
Liu Bei is nowhere to be seen, and Zhao Yun glares, ready to fight. The four back away. Lady Sun has the carriage pushed on.
军中又不见刘备，只见赵云怒目圆睁，只等厮杀。四将只好连声答应着退下。孙夫人叫人推车继续前进。
Behind them, Jiang Qin and Zhou Tai come up with the Marquis's sword: kill his sister first, then Liu Bei. Now all six generals follow along the river bank, and Zhou Yu comes by water.
背后蒋钦、周泰带着吴侯的剑赶到：先杀他妹妹，再斩刘备。于是六员将领沿着江岸追来，周瑜也从水路赶来。

s16.title: Liulangpu
steps: At Liulangpu, far from Chaisang now, Liu Bei breathes easier. He looks along the bank for a ferry: wide water, and not one boat.
刘备一行离柴桑渐渐远了，来到刘郎浦，心里才稍稍放宽。沿着江岸找渡口，只见一片江水茫茫，没有一只船。
My lord, you've come out of the tiger's mouth, and we're nearly home. The Directing General must have arranged something. Why worry?
主公从虎口里逃出来，现在已经快到自己的地界了。我料军师一定早有安排，何必担忧？
Liu Bei suddenly remembers the splendours of Wu, and tears come to his eyes.
刘备听了，忽然想起在东吴的繁华日子，不由得伤心落泪。
Dust rises behind them again. Liu Bei climbs a rise to look: the pursuers cover the ground.
忽然报后面尘土冲天。刘备登高一看，只见追兵铺天盖地而来。
Day after day running, men and horses worn out, and the pursuers come again. There's nowhere left even to die!
连日奔走，人困马乏，追兵又到，这下死无葬身之地了！
Then they see, lying along the bank, twenty-odd covered boats.
正在慌急的时候，忽然看见江岸边一字排开二十多只篷船。
Heaven sends us boats! Row across, and then we'll see.
老天保佑，这里有船！快划到对岸，再作打算！
Congratulations, my lord! Zhuge Liang has been waiting here a long time.
主公大喜！诸葛亮在这里等候多时了。
The men dressed as merchants in the boats are all Jingzhou marines. Soon the four generals ride up to the bank.
船里扮作客商的，都是荆州水军。不一会儿，四员将领赶到岸边。
I worked all this out long ago. Go back and tell Zhou Yu: no more beauty traps.
我早就算定了。你们回去告诉周郎，叫他别再使美人计了。
Arrows fly from the bank, but the boats are already far out.
岸上乱箭射来，船已经开远了。

A roar on the river: warships beyond counting, Zhou Yu himself under the commander's banner. Zhuge Liang runs the boats to the north shore; they land and go on by cart and horse. Zhou Yu lands and chases them on foot.
忽然江上喊声大震，只见战船无数，帅字旗下，周瑜亲自领着水军追来。诸葛亮叫船靠北岸，大家弃船上岸，坐车骑马继续走。周瑜也带兵上岸追赶。
A drum, and out of the valley comes a band of swordsmen, Guan Yu at their head. Zhou Yu turns and runs. Huang Zhong on the left and Wei Yan on the right cut in, and Wu's army breaks.
一声鼓响，山谷里冲出一队刀手，领头的正是关云长。周瑜手忙脚乱，拨马就逃。左边黄忠，右边魏延，两路兵马杀出，吴兵大败。
As Zhou Yu scrambles back into his boat, the soldiers on the shore shout together: Zhou Yu's brilliant plan to settle the realm: he gave away the bride and lost his army too!
周瑜急忙上船时，岸上的军士齐声大叫：“周郎妙计安天下，赔了夫人又折兵！”
Land again! We fight to the death!
再上岸，和他们决一死战！
My plan has failed. How can I face the Marquis?
我的计策没成，有什么脸去见吴侯！
He gives a great cry, his old wound bursts open, and he falls senseless in the boat. Whether he lives, hear the next chapter.
他大叫一声，箭伤迸裂，倒在船上，不省人事。周郎性命如何，且听下回分解。

opening: After the fire at Red Cliffs, Liu Bei holds Jingzhou, and Wu wants it back. Zhou Yu, Grand Commander of Wu, has a plan.
You are Zhao Yun, Liu Bei's general. You'll carry three silk pouches from Zhuge Liang. Each holds a plan, and each may be opened only at its moment.
赤壁大火之后，刘备占着荆州，东吴想要回来。东吴大都督周瑜想出了一条计策。
你是赵云，刘备的大将。你将带着诸葛亮给的三个锦囊。每个锦囊里有一条妙计，只能在该打开的时候打开。

gate.objective: Search the side rooms along the temple's corridors for hidden axemen.

dilemma.open: My son calls it a trick. I'll see the man with my own eyes.
dilemma.open_zh: 儿子说这是计策。我要亲眼看看这个人。

dilemma.open: If I'm to get home to Jingzhou, let one stroke split it.
dilemma.open_zh: 如果我能回到荆州，就让这一剑把它劈开。

dilemma.q: Find a way out of Wu.
dilemma.open: Mother may say yes; my brother never will. We need a day when no one asks where we're going.
dilemma.win: New Year's Day, by the river.
dilemma.open_zh: 母亲也许会答应，哥哥绝不会。得找一天，没人会问我们去哪儿。

dilemma.open: Say only what's true: his ancestors' graves are far away in the north. Leave out the rest.
dilemma.open_zh: 只说真话：他的祖坟远在北方。别的一句也不提。

dilemma.open: If my brother won't count me his own flesh and blood, I'll settle this myself.
dilemma.open_zh: 哥哥不把我当亲骨肉，今天的危难，我自己来解决。

worlds.name: The First Move

cafe_address.name: The café's address
cafe_address.text: A café in Jongno. The buyer is waiting. Go straight there.

requisition.name: Supplies requisition
requisition.text: For General Affairs. Kim Dong-sik's signature.

waybill_scrap.name: Waybill scrap
waybill_scrap.text: Glued to the waybill: a torn scrap of a weekly report. Internship. Kim Seok-ho.

borrowed_glue.name: The borrowed glue
borrowed_glue.text: Go's intern keeps borrowing Sales 3's supplies. Jang's glue stick was on Jang's desk, next to the waybill.

cabinet_key.name: Go's key ring
cabinet_key.text: Sales Team 1's supply cabinet key is on Go's key ring. His intern can't get at the glue.

links.q: Why does Go's intern keep borrowing our supplies?
links.a: Go walked off with the cabinet key. The kid has to beg for glue.

links.q: How did a Sales 3 waybill get down to the lobby?
links.a: He glued his report at Jang's desk, on top of the waybill. It went with him.

m1.title: Atari
steps: Misaeng means "not yet alive": on a go board, a group of stones that is neither alive nor dead.
It started when his uncle brought a set of stones round to the flat. The boy nearly swallowed a few, and loved them anyway.
Go on, then. Where would you play?

Baduk is good for concentration, his uncle said, and his mother gladly paid for the neighbourhood class. Soon he was winning his uncle's and his father's bets back from the man who ran the laundromat.

Next came an academy run by a strong amateur. His mother was against it, and nobody expected him to conquer the baduk world, but no one could stop a nine-year-old who got up at dawn to work through his problem book.
Then a professional's dojang, paid for by a sponsor who believed in him. People called him a prodigy, and the word soothed his parents like a sedative.
Then his father's company went under.
At eleven he joined the trainees' room: rows of boards, and children who all meant to turn professional.
Trainees have until eighteen to turn professional. He is eighteen now, and this is his last chance.

m2.title: Thrown Away
steps: At home, his parents cut out newspaper stories about Lee Chang-ho and Lee Sedol, their rankings and their prize money.
A baduk game is scored in points, and a draw is impossible: the smallest margin is half a point. For seven years he has lost that way, over and over.
He played it perfectly, and he's still half a point short. It's over.
Only now does he see his father's wrinkles, and how dull his mother's eyes have gone.
The day he leaves is an ordinary day. It feels as if he'll be back tomorrow, losing to younger kids again. He hasn't changed; everyone else has, and the colour has drained out of the world.
His friends from the trainees' room turned pro. They ask if he's really quitting, and he has no answer.
It wasn't talent, or luck, or all those half-point losses, or playing between part-time jobs. Those reasons would hurt too much. So he tells himself he just didn't try hard enough.
He walks away dropping stones from his pocket, a few at a time.
Because he didn't try hard enough, he had to come out into the world. Because he didn't try hard enough, he was thrown away.
At home he puts his game records out with the rubbish, along with his board.

m4.title: Washing Her Back
steps: Not long after he quit, his father died.
The family opened a small restaurant to get by, and it failed. His mother worked on building sites until her body gave out, and then she could barely get out of bed.
He studied for the high-school equivalency exam between part-time jobs. In the bathroom, he washed her back.
Then he did his military service.
He is home from the army: no degree, no trade, and a mother to look after.
Your old sponsor was asking after you, the man who paid for all your baduk. Go and see him.

m5.title: A Light Allowed Me
steps: A friend of mine runs a trading company, One International. I've spoken to him. He's the only one there who knows about your baduk, and it'll be a simple interview.
But your résumé is thin, and you'll be going in with nothing. Some people will call you a parachute: someone who only got in through connections.
As the city lights come on, office workers spill out to drink, flatter and head home. He'll start from the bottom like everyone else, and this time he won't fail the way he failed at baduk.
If there's a light I'm meant to keep burning, I'll take responsibility for it. But is there a light allowed for someone like me?
On the morning of his first day, he sleeps through the alarm twice. His mother ties his tie for him.

Across the city that same Wednesday, Oh Sang-sik, a section head at One International, is hiking up a mountain with his three sons. He has forgotten an eleven o'clock meeting with a buyer from overseas. On the summit, his phone rings: it's his own boss, the department head.
Where are you? The buyer's waiting, and if he walks out, we're both finished. I'm sending today's new hire. We're in no position to be picky.

m7.title: Fear Is Rational
steps: He makes it to the car, but the road into the city is crawling: five hundred metres in half an hour.
Someone at a workshop said most fear is irrational...
Shall I tell you about dismissal-notice pay?
I'm at the Mangwon-dong crossroads, doing twelve kilometres an hour, with eight to go. I'll be thirty minutes late. This fear is completely rational.

m8.title: Baduk, Not Go
steps: Jang's first-day message told him to skip the office and go straight to a café in Jongno. The overseas buyer and his manager, Kang, have been waiting there for an hour. Jang can't talk trade, but he can talk about one thing.
A puzzle? All right. I'm Black, and it's my move?
Oh bursts in, thirty minutes late, hiking clothes under his jacket.
Your young man kept us busy. The quiz was fun.

In Oh's car there are paper cups everywhere, and Oh argues a claim down the phone with red eyes. Jang once lost to a trainee just like him: sloppy, red-eyed, bored-looking. He'd taken him for careless, and he'd been wrong.
He's obsessive, and responsible: a man who carries everything himself.

I'm Kim Dong-sik, assistant manager on Sales Team 3. HR will brief you properly when we're back. I'm your buddy, and Section Head Oh is your mentor. First job: take this requisition to General Affairs.

m10_wait.title: General Affairs
steps: I should take the requisition to General Affairs first.

m10.title: Who Do You Think You Are?
steps: Jang Geu-rae, you'll be an intern with Sales Team 3. In two months the interns sit a PT, a presentation test. Pass it, and you stay on.
Two months, then. No degree, no experience, one phone call from a sponsor. If he fails the PT, he's out, and everyone will know he was only ever a parachute.
Eight weeks to the PT. His first real job is filing, and he means to do it better than anyone.
General Affairs hands over a box of supplies, a glue stick among them.
Sort these files into my folders.
He draws a mind map and designs a better filing system. It takes him all afternoon.
Where are my folders? Who do you think you are?
That filing system belongs to the company. This isn't work you do alone; it's work we do together.
At fifteen he filed his game records his own way, in a system only he ever had to read.
Interns' study group tonight. You're coming. Filing? It'll keep. We're going to work out who the dud is.
He has a whole cabinet to re-sort by morning. The glasses intern steers him out of the door anyway.

m12.title: Secure Yourself First
steps: The other interns are already sizing each other up. Everyone wants a partner who'll make them look good.
The bar is full of interns pitching PT topics. Every time Jang reaches for his bag to leave, the glasses intern refills his glass and pulls him back down.
Sit, sit. You can't leave before we've picked the dud. Well, we all know who it is.
Ahn Young-yi, top of their intake and the only woman there, has been watching. She catches Jang's sleeve and steers him out of the door, away from the noise.
Hey, new kid. Pull yourself together.
You haven't said a word all night. You won't learn just by listening.
And you've got filing due tomorrow, but you're sitting here? Make your own stones safe before you attack.
It's an old baduk proverb that even people who've never played use. He's lived by it his whole life, and he had to hear it from someone else. He runs back to the office.
You kept him here when you knew he had filing due tomorrow. Come on. You're going to go and apologise.

m13.title: Both Live
steps: Sorry. I shouldn't have kept you out.

On Jang's desk are two ways of filing the same papers: Kim's, which the whole team knows, and Jang's new one, which is better but only he understands. Kim wants his own back. One of them, it seems, has to go.
His system makes sense. The trouble is, everyone on staff already knows the old one.
In baduk, two groups locked together can sometimes both live, if neither side forces the issue. Ahn has found the way.
Keep Mr. Kim's order for the executives' file, but use Jang's cross-index from the planning stage. Then the departments could actually line up.
She kept her own group alive, and his too. Both live.
That night he dreams of a board: rows of white stones, and one black.

m14_wait.title: Every Side
steps: The call to the forwarder about the shipping papers, the B/L. The copies. The floor. All at once.

m14.title: The World Is Faster
steps: He's up before the alarm and crushed on the train. The world moves faster than he does.
Better plain and on time than perfect and late.
The PT dates are set: the first week of next month, a whole week at the training centre. There's an individual task and a team task, so start thinking about partners.
Everyone's going to want you. You've got no confidence and no skills, and if you pair with a sure dud, you shine.
Be careful of whoever comes to you first.

m16.title: Inside the Board
steps: Six weeks to the PT, and he still has no partner.
Whoever your partner is, trust them. As the saying goes, the player inside the game can't see his own moves, but everyone watching can.
A trainee sits at a board, ringed by onlookers. Everyone watching already knows how it ends.
Do your part, and trust the rest.
One by one the other interns pair off. Nobody asks him.
Have you picked a partner yet? Meet me on the roof tonight.

m17.title: Sente
steps: That night, the intern who asked about partners is waiting for him on the roof.
I'm Han Seok-yul. I came back from the Ulsan plant for the PT.
Sente is the initiative: the right to lead the game. He's always handed it over. This time he means to keep it.
Han reels it off: mechanical engineering, contest prizes, plant tours, foreign buyers, even a meal with the president. It's like stones slammed down by the handful.
Team up with me. You can build the PT however you like; just email me your progress.

m18.title: Again!
steps: Five weeks to the PT. Han said Jang could build it his way.
After years of fighting alone at a board, the office feels kinder and warmer. He emails Han three ideas for the PT.
Han texts back one word: Again!
At lunch, away from Jang, the glasses intern sidles up to Ahn.
Picked your partner yet? Not Jang, surely.
Jang's with Han. And they say Han made a big mistake in front of a buyer at Ulsan.
A total dud. Who's going to volunteer for the bomb squad?
Who knows? Maybe Jang's a big dud. A nuclear bomb.
Jang slips into the restroom and calls Han.
You said I could build it my way.
I said you'd share it with me. I never said I'd keep my mouth shut.
Then what kind of idea do you want?

At the Ulsan plant, Han is told he has one last chance and should go back to a desk if he isn't up to it. In Seoul, Jang sits at his screen beside an abandoned board. The world is far colder and more heartless than he thought.

m19.title: How Old Are You?
steps: Four weeks to the PT, and his partner keeps sending his work back.
He works all night on three new ideas, forty pages each. In the morning, Oh tears into a team document he made.
The colours don't match and the boxes are all over the place. What were you doing yesterday? Shrink the boxes.
He slips into an empty meeting room and calls Han.
Well? Should I do it again?
...The second one's good. Let's go with that.
He says it as if it were his to decide, and Jang's to obey.
Baduk is a war with a plain winner and loser, and he lived in it for over ten years. He may be a beaten soldier, but he was raised to compete, and he doesn't hand over sente.
Then we chose it together. From here on I'll write the PT my way. I'll keep you posted, but I won't be taking instructions.
In Korea, age decides who may talk down to whom. Han is older, and has talked down to him from the start. Now Jang drops the polite forms.
And how old are you, anyway?

m19c.title: The Eye of the Storm
steps: After too many short nights, he finally falls into a deep sleep, slumped in a chair in an empty meeting room.
His partner's Han Seok-yul, and Han's a talker. I bet Jang's doing all the work.
A smooth talker, and a kid who can't tell he's being used. Some team.
He dreams of his heroes, the great players: Cho Nam-chul, Cho Hunhyun, Lee Chang-ho, Lee Sedol. One by one they fade away. Hasn't he let go of baduk yet?
You were crying in your sleep. So your partner's Han? He'll use anyone to make himself shine.
An ambitious man is like a tornado. But the eye of a tornado is calm. If you can get to his centre, you two could make it work.
Wait, that's why I came! The seniors want all the interns out tonight. It's evening already; you slept the whole day.
He's late to the team dinner, so he has to down three penalty drinks. He laughs along with everyone, and still feels like a guest at someone else's table.

m20.title: The Waybill
steps: Three weeks to the PT. The interns are graded on everything, and one careless moment can sink any of them.
Anything with figures on it goes in the shredder. Not one of our papers should ever turn up outside this team.
He decides to shred the waybill later with the next batch, and leaves it on his desk: Sales Team 3, DH-14.
Can I borrow your glue? Our supply cabinet's locked and nobody will give me the key.
Kim Seok-ho, an intern on another team, glues his report together at Jang's desk, right on top of the waybill, and hurries off.
Jang hums as he feeds the shredder. Down in the lobby, a yellow sheet slides off the security desk onto the floor, and a passing director taps it with his shoe.
Director! Is this about a team dinner?
Without a word, the director kicks the team's paper box over. His aide hands Oh the waybill: they found it on the lobby floor.
Let's all do our jobs properly, shall we?
By the windows, Oh lines the interns up. Whose desk did that waybill come from?
It was mine. I left it on my desk.
Every intern turns to look at him. Three weeks before the PT, it goes on his record.
Kim Seok-ho stares at the floor.
Back at his desk, Oh turns the waybill over. Glued to the back is a torn scrap of someone's weekly report, with a name on it: Kim Seok-ho.

m21.title: A Secret
steps: Someone else's scrap, glued to Jang's waybill. Oh means to find out how it got there.
Applause from across the floor. Go, a section head on Sales Team 1, comes over pumping his fists.
My baby intern, Kim Seok-ho! He pulls all-nighters with us, he's newly married, he's the eldest son of an eldest son, and we've just landed the deal.
He comes over to our team a lot, to borrow supplies.
Ha! That's my fault. The supply cabinet key's on my key ring.
Oh looks at the waybill in his hands: a locked cabinet, a borrowed glue stick, and a scrap with a name on it.

m21b_wait.title: Oh's Desk
steps: Not yet. The scrap, the glue, the key... I need to put it together first.

m21b.title: Our Kid
steps: That evening Oh takes Jang and Kim out for a drink, and it isn't even nine before he's tipsy.
Geu-rae didn't do anything wrong today. Being misunderstood is a terrible thing.
At the next table, Sales Team 1 is celebrating its deal, Go and his intern Kim Seok-ho among them.
Jealous, Oh? You snub my intern over a few supplies, and now you want to spoil our win?
Get your intern his own glue! Our kid took the blame because yours got glue on a document and dropped it!
It doesn't sink in for Go, but it does for Kim Seok-ho.
Our kid. He called him our kid.
Stay on your toes, punk. The PT's coming.
Late that night, Kim Seok-ho gets home to his one-room flat. The baby is still awake and knows him at once. Her tiny hand closes round his finger.

m22.title: Their Own Baduk
steps: Two weeks to the PT. Every day is a lesson in what the job really is.

At first light he's at Incheon harbour, where cargo meant for Gunsan was unloaded by mistake, some of it damaged. He came to see it for himself; paperwork alone drifts away from what's really happening on site.

Back on the thirteenth floor, Steve Han, head of the Americas textile team, has come to pick a fight with Department Head Kim Bu-ryeon, who runs Sales Teams 1 to 3. They're the same rank, and everyone is watching.
I don't have time for a report this thick. A fat report is just a way for nobody to take responsibility.
My team was up all night on it.
I need to understand the client, not your catalogue. Who's it for? What's their climate? What do they like? Just tell me what I need.
Everyone is playing their own game of baduk. Whoever prepared better ends up happier with the result, and whoever rushed just to keep up has no excuse.
Why would Steve come down on our department head? Out with it.
Steve suggested dinner with the buyers, and I picked the place. I'd had a few drinks.

m22b.title: Dead Stones
steps: Go had taken a buyer, and Steve, to a dog-meat restaurant and never apologised. Ever since, Steve has been sitting on Sales Team 1's approvals.
And our department head is too sore to apologise. In a way, it's checkmate.
Checkmate: a janggi word, from Korean chess, used by a man who doesn't play baduk. Jang can't help grinning.
You're laughing while your seniors talk?
Apologising is the only way. In baduk, you don't leave dead stones lying on the board. Leave one there, and it grows into a bigger problem.
Then let's play politics with some class. Knowing when to bow your head: that's class. Let's go.
They go looking for Kim Bu-ryeon, only to find him already on the textile floor with Go, apologising to Steve. Then Go asks whether the approvals will go faster now, and everyone laughs.
Jang smiles to himself. The obvious move had been obvious to Department Head Kim too.
Often the obvious move is the hardest one to play. Some things you have to do however hard they are, and some you mustn't do however easy.
That night his mother asks how work was. Fine, he says, and for once it's true.

Two weeks to the PT. There will be dead stones in his own work too, and he'll have to give them up. He still isn't alive on this board, but for the first time he can see how a group like his might live.

opening: Every chapter of this story opens on one move of a real game: the 1st Ing Cup final, game 5, 1989. Nie Weiping has White. Cho Hunhyun has Black. It will last 145 moves.
Cho Hunhyun, who won it, was a hero to a boy who grew up with baduk. You are that boy, Jang Geu-rae. It begins with a set of stones, and a small boy who can't leave them alone.
closing: Sixteen moves played. Jang has a desk, a team that's on his side, a partner who no longer gives the orders, and a PT in a few weeks.
